jobs.description:
🚨 Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.

Ready to Empower a Growing Team and Shape Our Future?

At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Director of Talent Acquisition & People Operations to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.

About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.

Our Mission:
We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.

Our Vision:
We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.

Role Overview

As the Director of Talent Acquisition & People Operations, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top global talent, and you will own the broader people system that talent steps into. You will partner with leadership to design the recruiting engine that consistently delivers strong top-of-funnel for every open role, and you will scale the people systems that hold a remote, contractor-centric organization together as it grows toward $100M and beyond.

This is a leadership-tier role with 1 direct report (the People Operations Specialist) and end-to-end ownership of the talent and people functions. Your weeks will be heavier on recruiting in the near term, live pipelines, structured interviews, test projects, employer brand, and steady on People Operations throughout (onboarding, performance frameworks, contractor renewal, leadership enablement).

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition (the #1 outcome of this role):

• Recruiting Pipeline Management: Source candidates across LinkedIn, job boards, freelancer platforms, and referrals; filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and scorecard alignment.

• Test Project & Interview Operations: Run test projects, review submissions, conduct first-round group interviews, and manage candidate experience end-to-end.

• Sourcing Channel Optimization: Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance; build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles.

• Employer Brand & Glassdoor Defense: Monitor and manage Glassdoor reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, protect brand rating.

• Hiring Metrics & Funnel Reporting: Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role; track funnel performance against KPIs.

People Operations:

• People Systems Leadership: Design and implement systems for engaging, onboarding, and retaining talent, align

ed with the company's growth objectives.

• Organizational Design and Capacity Planning: Collaborate with leadership to ensure that the organizational structure and workforce planning meet the evolving needs of the business.

• Performance and Development Frameworks: Establish performance expectations, evaluation frameworks, and development pathways that drive accountability and growth across the organization.

• Talent Experience and Retention: Build a consistent and professional experience for talent that reinforces employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

• Workforce Insights and Reporting: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to leadership to guide decision-making and improve workforce effectiveness.

• External Partnerships: Partner with external service providers to enhance and support people operations as necessary.

How Success Is Measured

Talent Acquisition KPIs:

• Average time to fill open roles: under 45 days.

• Weekly applicant volume per active role: 250+ qualified applicants.

• Weekly hiring pipeline report by sourcing channel: 100% completion, on time.

• Completed candidate case studies available for review per role per week: 15+.

• Glassdoor company rating: maintain 4.5+ average across the year.

People Operations KPIs:

• Successful implementation of people systems that directly support the business's ability to scale.

• Strong employee retention rates, with high performance and engagement.

• Improved leadership confidence in people systems, talent readiness, and organizational alignment.

• Predictable, scalable people operations that contribute to the company's growth and success.

Requirements

Who You Are

You are a recruiting-strong, systems-oriented leader. You have personally closed difficult hires, not just managed a team that did. You move fast in a sourcing pipeline, you can run a structured interview that lands the right read on a candidate in 30 minutes, and you are equally comfortable defending the company on Glassdoor as you are building a 90-day onboarding plan. You thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first, contractor-centric environment and have a track record of both filling open roles ahead of timeline and scaling the people systems that retain the talent you bring in.

You Have / Requirements

Talent Acquisition / Recruiting (must-haves):

• 3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in remote or e-commerce organizations.

• Proven track record of hiring across marketing, ops, Amazon, product, and leadership roles.

• Experience running structured interviews, test projects, and group interviews.

• Familiarity with recruiting tech stacks: LinkedIn Recruiter, Workable, OnlineJobs.ph.

• Comfortable managing hiring systems using Notion, ClickUp, or lightweight ATS tools.

• Strong writing ability: clear job posts, compelling outreach, direct candidate comms.

• Ability to handle 5-10 active roles at a time with no drop-off in process.

• Experience defending brand reputation and responding to feedback (e.g. Glassdoor).

• Experience building and running reporting for hiring metrics.

People Operations (must-haves):

• 5+ years of progressive HR or people operations experience, with leadership responsibility.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.

• Direct experience operating contractor-centric or distributed teams.

• Demonstrated success building compliant, scalable people systems.

• Strong understanding of contractor classification, employment law, and risk mitigation.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Impact: Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand.
  • Culture: Join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote role with flexible working hours.
  • Benefits:
    • Remote-first work environment
    • Paid time off and holidays
    • Access to learning resources and professional development
    • Free access to Hadley Designs products
    • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO and CMO
    • Stability from a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Apply Today

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact in a growing company that’s shaping the future of learning, apply now to join the Hadley Designs team as our Director of Distributed Team Operations. Help us create a lasting impact on families, educators, and children worldwide.

P.S: If you don’t hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.

Job Description - Product Manager

Reports To: SVP of Product

Position Summary

As a Product Manager at AxisCare, you will own the discovery, shaping, and delivery of features across our home care platform. This role sits at the center of our product organization: you have enough experience to drive initiatives independently, and the judgment to know when to escalate or align.

At AxisCare, AI isn’t a tool we experiment , but how we work. Every PM on our team uses AI-assisted tools as a core part of their daily practice: shaping requirements, accelerating research, prototyping, and validating ideas faster than traditional methods allow. We expect PMs to be fluent in these tools and to actively push the boundaries of what’s possible with them.

You will work closely with Engineering, UX, and cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes that matter to customers and move the business forward.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own defined product areas end-to-end — from discovery and requirements through delivery, launch, and adoption.
  • Use AI-assisted tools daily to draft requirements, prototype concepts, explore edge cases, and accelerate the path from customer problem to validated

    solution.

  • Develop a deep understanding of customer needs through direct engagement, collaboration with Customer Success and Support, and ongoing analysis of usage data.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to understand prospect needs and translate market signals into product opportunities.
  • Write clear, well-reasoned product requirements and user stories in partnership with Engineering and UX.
  • Build and maintain roadmaps for your product area, communicating priorities and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders.
  • Lead go-to-market preparation for your features — including enablement materials, release documentation, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Track adoption and performance metrics post-launch and use findings to inform next iterations.
  • Participate in customer calls, industry events, and prospect discussions as a product representative.

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 2–4 years of product management experience, ideally in a SaaS environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to own a product area independently — defining problems, driving decisions, and seeing work through to measurable outcomes.
  • Strong fluency with AI-assisted tools and genuine enthusiasm for working in an AI-forward environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to align cross-functional teams around a clear problem and plan.
  • Analytical mindset — comfortable with data, metrics, and using evidence to inform decisions.
  • Strong collaboration skills with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market teams.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Willingness to travel up to 15% as needed.
  • Proficiency with product and development tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field or equivalent professional experience.

What We'd Be Excited to Find (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience in home care, healthcare, or a related industry.

Working Conditions

  • Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals.
  • Utilization of software and email to perform job functions.
  • Will need to conduct camera-on videoconferencing for customer calls.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Medical insurance premiums are covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental and Vision) 
  • 401K with competitive company matching.
  • Personal time off, sick leave, and holidays.
  • Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment.

About AxisCare

According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.

AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more userfriendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 7 other countries. We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment.

jobs.description:
The Company

EXADS is an international ad-tech software start-up. In business since 2013, we're self-sufficient, well-funded and privately owned, with offices in Dublin and Porto, and part of the wider EXOGROUP (headquartered in Barcelona, with an office in Valencia - 200+ people).

We actively develop and maintain our own proprietary ad-serving platform and custom-built infrastructure, enabling us to innovate and ship new features quickly in a fast-moving, demanding industry. We're revolutionising online ad-serving for advertisers, publishers and networks alike.

Role:

As we scale, we need a Technical Success Manager who bridges the gap between our sophisticated technology and our clients' success. You'll make complex technology accessible, reduce support burden, and empower clients and colleagues alike to understand, and get the most from our platform. You'll be expected to manage a dynamic workload, work to SLAs, prioritising effectively, sometimes under pressure, and finding creative solutions.

This is a start-up style environment, not a large support function. You'll regularly be handed technical problems, which are not fully documented, often with no established playbook, and be expected to investigate and make a genuine start yourself, using the platform, the tooling and your own judgement, drawing on your relevant experience, before pulling in engineering; we'll support you with a company Claude subscription. You don't need to be a software developer, but this is a hands-on technical role: if you've never touched a query, a console log or version control, it isn't the right fit. If you prefer fully-documented processes and a clear signposted path for everything before you begin, this isn't the role. If a small, fast-moving team where you own problems end-to-end excites you without the fear of making mistakes, you'll thrive.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own, investigate and solve technical problems independently, making decisions with little or no guidance where required, and attempting to resolve issues before escalating (in many cases).
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, including RTB reporting and impression discrepancies, reasoning about why they arise in the first place and driving them to resolution with clients and developers.
  • Be the go-to technical point of contact for the team, making EXADS easier for both clients and colleagues to understand.
  • Author and maintain internal process documentation for the team to follow, and provide critical feedback to Product on existing client-facing documentation (Product owns the client docs; you help make them accurate and clear).
  • Support the Sales team in winning new business, and relay complex technical concepts clearly to the team, clients and leads.Prioritise, escalate or directly resolve support tickets, working consistently to define SLAs.
  • Provide visibility and updates on the most important ongoing issues, and establish scalable processes that uplift productivity and efficiency for EXADS and its clients.
  • Liaise with developers and product to request new features, report bugs, ask questions, document issues accurately and escalate issues where necessary, taking ownership to report back to the client on resolutions.
  • Assist in setting up and deploying new platforms for clients, including enabling new ad formats, features, payment methods, and connecting campaigns/zones.
  • Mentor other team members, helping them understand and interpret technical data.
  • Initiate and lead client calls and video meetings with confidence, asking sharp, leading diagnostic questions of both clients and developers to troubleshoot effectively.
  • Develop deep, hands-on knowledge of our product lines, roadmap and ad-network platform, commercial and technical, and how to implement changes.
  • When you do escalate to engineering you ask relevant questions to stakeholders to reduce resolution time.

What you bring:

  • A self-starter mentality with strong organisation. You proactively keep your own records so tasks are easy to replicate and improve, and you teach yourself what you don't yet know rather than waiting to be shown.
  • Comfortable getting hands-on with the technical/data layer. You're not dependent on someone else to interpret it for you.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control, and with web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), including using browser developer tools/console logs to review data and diagnose issues.
  • Confidence in communicating with clients and developers alike, leading meetings, asking the right questions, and translating between the two.
  • Strong written, spoken and interpersonal communication skills (English), with the ability to produce clear, concise documentation.A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to communicate across Jira, HubSpot, Slack and GitHub.
  • Excellent understanding of the online advertising industry.
  • Experience working with APIs and an understanding of how they're called and used.
  • Working SQL literacy: you can write, read and interpret queries, understand relational concepts (joins, filters, schema), and modify existing ones with reasoning. You won't need production-grade SQL, but you must be comfortable working in the data layer.
  • A solid technical background focused on web technologies, and genuine problem-solving instinct: you make a start on undocumented problems and use the tools available (including AI tooling) to work them out.

Considered a plus:

  • Hands-on experience with other ad-serving platforms (e.g. Kevel, Google Ad Manager or similar) is highly desirable.
  • Experience with AI models and tooling beyond chatting with LLMs, and familiarity with Claude Code, Codex or similar.
  • Experience delivering technical training and webinars.
  • Experience configuring HubSpot automations and using HubSpot Service Desk.
  • Previous GitHub projects you have worked on or contributed to.
  • Experience supporting and communicating with clients on a SaaS online platform.
  • Coding experience.
  • Experience with RTB technology.

What we offer:

A position in a young, dynamic, international environment, with permanent training, personal development, ambitious career growth and a competitive salary based on experience. Critical-skills visa and relocation package available for the right candidate.

Most of all, a team that thrives on achievement, success and industry leadership. Our core value is innovation — people and creativity driving technology. If you enjoy a fast-paced, challenging and rewarding environment and take ownership by instinct, this position is for you.

Experience our benefits:

  • Flexible start times;
  • Summer Schedule;
  • Private health insurance;
  • Remote work from home;
  • Home office set up budget of 500 Euros;
  • Your Birthday off as a paid holiday;
  • Access to quality trainings through Udemy platform;
  • Additional internal and external trainings through our EXOGROUP University program;
  • Up to 1500 Eur of training budget and 5 days of study leave, every year;
  • Flexible compensation of 500 Euros/year;
  • Spanish, English, and Portuguese language lessons;
  • Employee referral program bonus - Earn 2500 Euros by referring someone!
  • Subsidized Well-being activites;
  • Exciting team buildings in locations such as Ibiza;
  • Calm App subscription;
  • Office Perks;
  • Meal card;
  • Relocation Package;

Is this not the right role for you? Then make sure to check out all other roles we have open for you on our careers website.

You’ll translate executive priorities into action, lead strategic initiatives, improve business processes, and provide leadership with the visibility needed to make informed decisions. Success in this role requires exceptional business judgment, operational excellence, and the ability to influence across teams without direct authority.

Strategic Planning & Execution

Operations & Business Performance

  • Improve internal processes, systems, and operating procedures.
  • Support quarterly planning, annual planning, and business reviews.
  • Develop executive dashboards and performance reporting.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accountability, and scalability.

Communication & Organizational Alignment

  • Draft executive communications and company-wide updates.
  • Ensure consistent messaging across teams and stakeholders.
  • Support leadership communications related to strategic initiatives and partnerships.
  • Reinforce company culture, organizational alignment, and business priorities.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with business goals.
  • Executive leadership operates with greater focus and efficiency.
  • Cross-functional teams remain aligned and accountable.
  • Business reporting provides clear visibility into performance.
  • Operational processes scale effectively alongside company growth.
  • Leadership has timely insight into priorities, risks, and execution.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You think strategically while executing with urgency.
  • You solve problems before they become roadblocks.
  • You influence teams without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate confidently with executives and stakeholders.
  • You remain organized while managing multiple high-priority initiatives.
  • You thrive in ambiguity and fast-changing environments.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in:
    • Chief of Staff
    • Strategy
    • Operations
    • Business Management
    • Consulting
    • Executive Leadership
  • Experience working directly with CEOs, founders, or executive leadership teams.
  • Proven success leading cross-functional initiatives and strategic projects.
  • Strong business acumen and operational decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and execution skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.

Nice to Have

  • MBA or other advanced degree.
  • Experience in:
    • High-growth startups
    • Technology companies
    • Consulting firms
    • Scaling organizations
  • Background in:
    • Management Consulting
    • Investment Banking
    • Corporate Strategy
    • Business Operations
  • Experience supporting board reporting and executive planning.
  • Experience leading organizational change and process improvement initiatives.

Tech Stack

  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • Google Workspace
  • Project Management Tools
    • Asana
    • Monday.com
    • Notion
    • Similar platforms
  • Executive dashboards and KPI reporting tools
  • CRM and business productivity platforms
  • AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar)

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Meet with the CEO to review priorities and strategic initiatives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional projects and leadership action items.
  • Monitor KPIs and business performance dashboards.
  • Prepare executive presentations, reports, and communications.
  • Lead follow-ups on strategic initiatives across departments.
  • Remove execution bottlenecks and improve operational workflows.
  • Support leadership meetings, planning sessions, and business reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to improve organizational efficiency and scalability.

In short: You’ll serve as the CEO’s strategic partner, ensuring company priorities are executed effectively while aligning teams, improving operations, and driving organizational performance.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Strategic initiative completion rate.
  • Executive priority execution.
  • Cross-functional project delivery.
  • KPI reporting accuracy and visibility.
  • Operational efficiency improvements.
  • Stakeholder and leadership satisfaction.
  • Organizational alignment and accountability.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct partnership with the CEO and executive leadership.
  • High ownership over strategy, operations, and company execution.

  • Exposure to executive decision-making and company-wide initiatives.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Career progression into:
    • VP of Operations
    • Chief Operating Officer (COO)
    • General Manager
    • Executive Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your experience supporting CEOs and executive leadership, and explain how you’ve led strategic initiatives, improved operations, aligned cross-functional teams, and driven organizational execution. You’ll also have the opportunity to highlight your leadership style, business judgment, and experience managing high-impact projects in fast-paced environments. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

As a senior technical leader, you’ll partner closely with engineering, AI, and product teams to drive innovation, define our ML strategy, and mentor others in applying best practices for scalable, responsible AI.

This is both a hands-on and strategic role. You will lead complex, end-to-end ML initiatives—from model design and experimentation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement—while advancing the evolution of SailPoint’s AI platform, data pipelines, and model governance standards.

About the team:

The AI team at SailPoint applies AI and domain expertise to create AI solutions that solve real problems in identity security. Preferred

  • Experience designing AI platforms or reusable ML services that support multiple product lines.

1 year:

  • Mentor and elevate other engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

Reports to: Katie Fortunato, Co-Founder & President Direct Reports: Creator Community & Growth Manager

Compensation: $120k-$170k + bonus

Location: US-based, remote. Open to US travel as needed, estimate about quarterly

About Jobstream™

Jobstream™ is defining a new category at the intersection of the creator economy and talent discovery. We are the first Career Creator network, enabling creators to earn income by helping their audiences discover real jobs. Everything runs through the Career Creator Network™, our community of career creators growing together.

Backed by 25+ years of human capital infrastructure through Hire Innovations, we operate with startup speed and enterprise support. You will report into the Co-Founder and President and be considered part of the founding team. This next year is about going to market, and you will be at the center of it.

We build for the visual world. We show instead of tell. We protect what is human in the job search. And the brand can never fail.

Role Overview

The Head of Growth Marketing owns two sides of the same flywheel: the creator network and the enterprise brand campaigns it powers. Client delivery and fulfillment succeed end to end when creators are thriving, engaged, and earning. That flywheel is yours.

On one side, you own the growth engine: the profile of the brand, creator acquisition across every persona, and the health of the community everything depends on. On the other, you make sure that engine delivers. The team owns campaign execution; you hold them accountable to it, ensuring the community and growth systems work as one flywheel so that when a client campaign needs the network, the network is ready.

You bring proven growth playbooks from ecommerce and digital businesses and apply them to a new category-defining creator platform. Creator monetization runs on these mechanics: conversion funnels, performance data, retention loops, and brand partnerships that renew because they work.

This is a doer's role first and a leader's role second. Our philosophy is simple: we build the systems ourselves, then hire for what we can't do. You architect the playbook and you run it, hands on, and direct and grow the growth marketing function. Your first direct report is the Creator Community & Growth Manager, a creator-native operator who serves as the day-to-day, peer-level face of the community. You set the strategy, priorities, and standard; they bring the lived growth by community credibility. Together you cover the full picture. The leadership path here is earned through building. Stage one: you do the work and build the systems. Stage two: you document the playbooks and delegate what is repeatable. Stage three: you own the full growth function, with a team you shaped across creator acquisition and campaign delivery, and scope that expands as the systems you built prove out. You are creating the standard of excellence from the onset, and the function grows around it.

  • Strong networking fundamentals – Everything below builds on this, and it is not negotiable
  • Deep expertise in routing protocols and technologies, including BGP, OSPF, and static routing, with hands-on experience in route policy design, route redistribution, filtering, and traffic engineering
  • Understanding of network virtualization and software-defined networking, including VRFs, multi-tenant network architectures, SD-WAN, and the encapsulation protocols used to build overlays at scale (GRE, VXLAN, GENEVE and similar)
  • Hands-on experience with IPsec VPNs, encryption standards, NAT, and secure connectivity architectures
  • Good understanding of how enterprises extend cloud connectivity using a variety of Networking Technologies (i.e. Cloud On-Ramps, SD-WAN and IPsec)
  • Experience in large-scale enterprise network design and deployment experience across data center, WAN and hybrid/multi-cloud
  • A deep understanding of network services — DNS, DHCP, load balancing, traffic inspection and similar
  • The ability to troubleshoot live, in front of a customer, across routing, security and cloud domains
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort presenting and demoing to customers in person – In this role you are the technical credibility of the company

Strongly preferred

  • Understanding of cloud networking constructs across AWS, Azure, and GCP (e.g., VPCs/VNets, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, Cloud Router, peering, and hybrid connectivity such as Direct Connect and ExpressRoute)
  • Network security expertise, including firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Check Point), firewall policy design, service insertion/chaining, and Zero Trust principles

Alkira, a Lumen Connect® solution, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload.

Founded by Amir and Atif Khan, the creators of Viptela and pioneers of the SD-WAN market, Alkira was built to radically simplify how enterprises deploy and manage network infrastructure. Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world's largest enterprises.

Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.

At Alkira, you'll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

Join us and help build the future of networking.

Research Associate

Location Remote

Business Cohen Veterans Network, Inc.

A Career with Cohen Veterans Network, Inc

At Cohen Veterans Network, we seek to improve the quality of life for veterans, including those from the National Guard and Reserves, active duty, and their families. CVN works to strengthen mental health outcomes and complement existing support. Our vision is to ensure that every veteran, active-duty service member, and family member can obtain access to high-quality care that enables them to lead fulfilling and productive lives. The Cohen Veterans Network, Inc., is a not-for-profit philanthropic organization (a registered 501c3 Private Foundation).

What you will do

We are seeking a post-doctoral research /associate scientist with a focus on quantitative data management and analysis to join our team in a full time permanent position. Under the Deputy Director, Institute for Quality, you will, conduct literature reviews and syntheses, develop research questions to interrogate through CVNs archival and/or prospective data collection mechanisms and methods and will identify and pursue grant funding opportunities to expand and enhance our research portfolio and impact on the field. You will also support internal operations research and quality improvement projects, optimizing clinical care and organizational processes to ensure CVN remains a learning mental health network and advancing the field.

Specifically, you will:

  • Conceptualize proposed research projects based on subject matter knowledge, experience and critical evaluation of existing evidence including the peer reviewed literature
  • Develop and apply a range of analytic techniques and methodologies and research designs; conduct and present analyses of archival and prospective data
    • Conduct EHR-based data extraction, transformation, and analysis using SQL and R and/or Python
    • Support operational analytics needs across clinical programs (e.g., outcomes tracking, measurement-based care, program evaluation)
    • Build reproducible data pipelines and analytic workflows
    • Collaborate with clinical, operational, and data engineering teams to ensure data quality and usability
    • Apply research, data analytic tools, and methodologies to address and resolve clinical and operational challenges/problems in conjunction with the IQ team, other departments and CVN leadership.
    • Support program evaluation efforts and operational projects and studies
  • Translate complex findings into actionable insights for scientific and non-technical audiences
  • Work collaboratively in a multi-disciplinary team to support internal research initiatives, research grants, CVN’s Scientific Advisory Board, and cross-collaboration between CVN-IQ and other departments and clinics in the network
  • Assist in development, review and submission of grant application, research proposals, IRB protocols.
  • Perform miscellaneous job-related duties or other projects assigned.

What’s required

  • Doctorate, (PhD) in a clinical psychology or related clinical/social science field
  • 5-7 years’ experience (includes doctoral training) in a research institute or academic setting
  • Subject matter knowledge or expertise in clinical or experimental psychology or related field

Staff Inspector (Organic Certifiers)
Remote, California

Company Description
For more than three decades, FoodChain ID has been at the forefront of the New Food industry, helping companies navigate increasing global demands for transparency, accountability, safety, and sustainability.

Job Description

Inspect operations seeking or maintaining USDA organic certification to assess compliance with National Organic Program (NOP) regulations. The position will be responsible for completing the following types of inspections/assignments: Initial, Annual, Additional, Limited Scope, Unannounced, Sampling, Remote Desk Audits, Peer Witness Evaluations.

Duties and Responsibilities
  • Coordinate with producers/handlers to schedule initial, annual, and any follow-up inspections within a determined timeframe.
  • Schedule and conduct field/facility inspections in accordance with all Organic Certifier’s (OC) policies and work instructions and in line with the National Organic Program standards.
  • Collect food, product, or environmental samples from client sites and ship samples to designated laboratories for testing.
  • Interview operation personnel, request and review operation records, and conduct site inspections to assess compliance with the standards.
  • Report observations and inspection findings in required OC documents (inspection report, etc.).
  • Adequately document reported findings with evidence collected at inspection.
  • Submit all required documents (as defined by OC Work Instructions) by the due date of the assignment.
  • Conduct unannounced inspections and gather samples in accordance with NOP Regulations and OC Policies and Work Instructions.
  • Maintain effective and prompt communication with supervisor, colleagues, and clients.
  • Participate in witness audits and/or peer evaluations as required.
  • Remain abreast of NOP regulatory changes and updates to OC’s policies, procedures, and best practices.
  • Complete a minimum of 150 inspection assignments per year.
  • Support department with procedural and technical policy review and calibration.
  • Witness, train, and/or evaluate peer inspectors as needed, based on qualifications.
  • Support in delivery of quarterly Inspector Feedback. Provide technical support to other inspectors as needed.
  • Develop training materials and guidance documents and participate in quarterly trainings as needed.
  • Complete OC-assigned trainings and maintain inspector qualifications as required by NOP standards.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications
  • Education & Experience
    • Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, food science, environmental science, quality management, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
    • Inspectors must be able to demonstrate a minimum of 2,000 hours (1 year) of experience relevant to the scope and complexity of operations they will inspect (eligible experience includes but is not limited to; work on a farm or ranch, agricultural extension work, agricultural education, internships, apprenticeships, experiential education, 4-H, FFA, other inspecting/auditing work, experience at a food processing/handling operation, food processing research, natural resource management work).
  • Technical Expertise
    • Comprehension of NOP regulations (7 CFR Part 205), the NOP Handbook, and the National List.
  • Certification & Training
    • Documentation of sufficient training to demonstrate relevant knowledge, skills, and experience required to inspect operations of the scope and complexity assigned and to evaluate compliance with applicable regulations.
  • Skills & Attributes
    • Excellent analytical and report-writing skills.
    • Strong interpersonal abilities for interviewing and relationship-building.
    • Self-motivation and ability to work independently.
    • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal). Ability to speak English/Spanish preferred.
    • Willingness and ability to travel.
    • Computer literacy (able to use electronic inspection platforms, GPS, digital photography). Experience with Microsoft Office Suite, i.e. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.
    • Must have a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

Training Requirements

Prior to Formal Authorization:
  • Initial basic training on policies, forms, files, web-system, etc.
  • Standards training as appropriate (NOP, etc.)
  • Inspectors with less than one year of inspection experience must complete at least 50 hours of training prior to performing inspections independently.
  • Each inspector will be evaluated while performing an inspection at least once every three years, or more frequently if warranted. Inspectors with less than three years of inspection experience must undergo a witness inspection annually.
  • Monitored training period as needed to demonstrate competence.

Yearly Requirements to Maintain Authorization:
  • Inspectors with one or more years of experience will maintain 10 hours of continued education every year if inspecting one area of operation and an additional 5 hours for each additional area of operation inspected.
  • Attendance of Annual OC Meetings and Quarterly Trainings.
  • Attendance of any additional trainings as deemed necessary.

🌍 We’re making security suck less for developers.

Security tools haven’t kept up with how software is built today. They interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck instead of a capability. We built Aikido to change that. Aikido builds developer-first security products that reduce real risk without getting in the way of shipping software. We focus on what actually matters and automate the rest.

We’re taking on legacy security tools teams have been stuck with, and we’re winning. If you want to help us take market share and build products developers actually enjoy using, you’re in the right place.

Job Title: Process & Automation Specialist
Location: Remote
Role Type: Full-Time

Who Are We?
At Reef, we connect elite talent with high-growth companies building world-class teams.

We work exclusively with the top 3% of candidates and match them with established companies across Australia, New Zealand, the US, and UK that are serious about investing in their people and operational infrastructure.

We support your integration into these companies by providing additional training, admin/HR support, and access to our growing community of high-performing professionals.

About the Company
Our client is a growing Australian business focused on improving operational efficiency through systems, process optimisation, and automation.

As the business scales, they are investing in reducing manual workflows, improving cross-functional efficiency, and implementing automation across sales, fulfilment, and internal operations to support long-term growth.

With fragmented systems and repetitive processes creating operational bottlenecks, the company is now seeking a specialist who can identify inefficiencies, build scalable automation solutions, and improve how the business runs.

About the Role
We’re seeking an experienced Process & Automation Specialist to analyse existing workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and design and implement automation systems that reduce manual work and improve efficiency.

You’ll act as both a consultant and builder - mapping business processes, diagnosing inefficiencies, and implementing practical automation solutions using tools such as N8N, Zapier, Make.com, APIs, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude.

The role will span core functions including sales workflows, fulfilment processes, and internal operations, with a focus on reducing repetitive tasks, improving system reliability, and creating scalable processes that support growth.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys solving operational problems, building systems, and creating measurable impact through automation.

Requirements

Excellent spoken and written English

Previous experience in process improvement, operations, automation, or systems implementation

Strong experience using tools such as N8N, Zapier, Make.com, APIs, or similar automation platforms

Experience working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI-powered workflow tools

Ability to analyse business workflows, identify inefficiencies, and translate them into automation solutions

Strong systems thinking and problem-solving ability

Experience documenting workflows, SOPs, and process maps

Comfortable integrating systems across CRMs, communication tools, and operational platforms

High attention to detail and ability to test and maintain reliable automations

Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Fast and reliable internet connection; your own laptop or desktop suitable for the role; a quiet working environment

Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience

Performance-based bonus structure tied to automation outcomes and efficiency improvements

Opportunity to play a key role in building scalable systems and operational infrastructure

Growth potential as the company expands its automation capabilities

Access to other job opportunities through REEF

jobs.description:
会社概要

弊社は、MITとStanford大学院の卒業生によって2021年4月に創業されたリーガルテック企業です。創業当初からプロダクトへの高い信頼度を武器に、これまでほぼ口コミ・紹介のみで顧客基盤を拡大し、約4年間にわたり外部からの資金調達を行わずに急激な成長を遂げました。

結果として、今では日本の5大法律事務所やLINEヤフー社、メルカリ社などをはじめとする、数百の優良顧客へ導入いただいております。また、既に米国や韓国をはじめとする国外へもプロダクトを展開しております。

会社概要

BoostDraftは現在50名規模となり、国内での強固な事業基盤を土台に、APACをはじめとするグローバル展開を本格化させる重要な転換期を迎えています。本ポジションには、COOの右腕として事業全体を俯瞰し、全社視点でのリソース最適化と非連続な成長を牽引する役割を期待しています。戦術的なオペレーションの枠を越え、「どこで、どう勝つか」という純粋な事業戦略を描き、その実行を主導する事業成長の要となっていただきます。そして、中長期的にはJapan Business Headとして、営業、マーケティング、カスタマーサクセスなどの各ビジネス部門を統括し、日本市場における事業成長のトップとして組織を牽引していただくことを想定しています。

想定業務:

  • 経営課題の特定と解決策の実行
    • 事業の成長を阻害している根本的な課題の特定と構造化
    • 各部門（営業、カスタマーサクセス等）を横断する業務プロセスの見直し、および改善プランの策定
    • 策定した戦略に基づく各現場への実行プランの落とし込み、および複数部門を巻き込んだプロジェクトの完遂
  • 日本事業の成長戦略および新規事業の立案
    • データ分析に基づく、既存事業の売上拡大に向けた最も効果的な打ち手の特定と検証
    • 市場調査や顧客へのヒアリングを通じた、新規事業や新機能におけるビジネスモデルの検討
  • 海外拠点との連携およびグローバル展開の支援
    • 韓国や北米のBizOps担当者との連携、およびメンタリング
    • 各国の市場動向や成功事例の統合を通じた、APAC市場への展開戦略の構築
  • 重要顧客・パートナーとの関係構築
    • 大手企業の意思決定層に対する、経営視点での直接的な提案や重要交渉
    • 事業拡大を目的とした他社との戦略的な提携、およびアライアンス交渉への参画
  • 経営の意思決定を支えるデータ分析体制の構築
    • 各部門に散在する事業データの統合、およびKPIの可視化
    • 経営陣が迅速かつ的確な意思決定を行うためのモニタリング体制の整備と運用

※上記はあくまで想定業務となります

BoostDraftの魅力:

  • 創業から約4年間資金調達を行わずに事業拡大をした稀有なスタートアップ環境
  • 優秀な人財に囲まれたチャレンジングな環境 (Microsoft, NTT, BCG出身者等)
  • インターナショナルなチーム環境 (従業員の約半数が外国籍のメンバー)
  • マネジメント層含め、小さなお子様を抱えているメンバーも活躍中

Requirements

必須経験/スキル -

  • ビジネスレベルの英語力、およびネイティブレベルの日本語力

また、下記のいずれか一つ

  • 戦略コンサルティングファーム、または総合系コンサルティングファームでの実務経験（マネージャー等、プロジェクトリードの経験を想定）
  • スタートアップ企業（数十名〜百名規模）における事業開発、経営企画、またはBizOps等の実務経験

歓迎経験/スキル

  • B2B ソフトウェア領域における事業成長の知見
  • グローバルチーム、または多国籍なメンバーとの協働・マネジメント経験

求める人物像

  • 「自ら手を動かすこと」を厭わず、カオスな環境を楽しめるハンズオン志向
  • 「第二創業期」のスピード感と変化を楽しみ、自ら課題解決に取り組める強いオーナーシップを持つ方。
  • 策定した戦略を、他部門を巻き込みながら粘り強く実行し、成果につなげる高いコミットメント力。
  • 自律的に高いパフォーマンスを発揮しつつ、グローバルチームへの貢献を欠かさない方。

jobs.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.
AHEAD is seeking a Senior Technical Consultant to join the Enterprise Networking team. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting complex enterprise network solutions across routing, switching, BGP-based enterprise and WAN architectures, wireless, and network access control environments. The ideal candidate brings strong consulting presence, deep technical expertise, and hands-on experience delivering network infrastructure projects for enterprise clients.

Key Responsibilities

    · Design and implement enterprise network solutions across campus, branch, and datacenter environments

    · Lead technical discovery, architecture, design workshops, and deployment activities for client engagements

    · Develop high-quality low-level and high-level design documentation, implementation plans, and test plans

    · Configure, validate, and troubleshoot routing and switching platforms in complex production environments

    · Perform wireless site surveys, predictive designs, and post-deployment validation using Ekahau

    · Design and implement enterprise wireless solutions with a focus on coverage, capacity, roaming, and performance

    · Deploy and support Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) for network access control, authentication, authorization, and policy enforcement

    · Provide technical leadership during implementation, migration, cutover, and optimization activities

    · Collaborate with project managers, architects, engineers, and client stakeholders to ensure successful delivery

    · Mentor junior consultants and contribute to technical best practices within the enterprise networking team

    · Support pre-sales efforts through solution reviews, level-of-effort input, and technical recommendations

Required Qualifications

    · Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related experience

    · Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise network solutions

    · CCNP certification required, with strong focus on routing, switching, and BGP

    · Strong knowledge of BGP design, implementation, policy control, path selection, and troubleshooting in enterprise environments

    · CWNA certification required

    · Proven network design experience in enterprise environments

    · Hands-on experience with enterprise routing and switching platforms, including Cisco Catalyst and Nexus switches, protocols, and architectures

    · Hands-on experience conducting wireless surveys and wireless design using Ekahau

    · Experience designing, deploying, and troubleshooting enterprise wireless networks

    · Experience with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) deployments and policy-based access control

    · Strong understanding of LAN, WAN, WLAN, TCP/IP, VLANs, STP, HSRP/VRRP, OSPF, BGP, QoS, and DHCP/DNS fundamentals

    · Ability to create clear technical documentation, diagrams, implementation plans, and client deliverables

    · Strong communication, presentation, and customer-facing consulting skills

    · Ability to manage multiple priorities across project-based work

Preferred Qualifications

Sans être exhaustifs, voici les services et livrables que devra fournir la personne retenue :

  • Participer à l’analyse, à la modélisation et à la valorisation des données;
  • Développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord et rapports décisionnels;
  • Concevoir des modèles de données adaptés aux besoins d’affaires;
  • Développer des processus ETL pour l’intégration et la migration des données;
  • Assurer la qualité, l’intégrité et la cohérence des données;
  • Participer à l’évolution des plateformes analytiques et décisionnelles;
  • Produire la documentation fonctionnelle et technique;
  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’affaires, d’architecture et de développement;
  • Participer à l’automatisation des processus de traitement des données;
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques en intelligence d’affaires.

Requirements

  • Détenir un diplôme universitaire de premier cycle en informatique ou dans une discipline appropriée;
  • Détenir une certification reconnue dans le domaine des technologies de l’information;
  • Une certification ITIL ou en gestion de projet constitue un atout;
  • Une certification Microsoft Power BI constitue un atout;
  • Posséder plus de deux (2) années d’expérience pertinente en intelligence d’affaires;
  • Démontrer une expertise en modélisation de données avec SQL Server et Power BI;
  • Maîtriser Power Query et les stratégies d’actualisation des données;
  • Posséder une expérience en développement de processus ETL;
  • Détenir une expérience avec les plateformes de données infonuagiques constitue un atout;
  • Posséder une expérience avec Power Apps et Power Automate constitue un atout;
  • Maîtriser la suite BI Microsoft (SQL Server, SSIS et Power BI);
  • Maîtriser les langages SQL, DAX et PowerShell;
  • Posséder des connaissances des langages Python ou R constitue un atout;
  • Démontrer un bon sens de l’analyse, de l’organisation et de la documentation;
  • Faire preuve d’autonomie, d’initiative et d’un excellent esprit d’équipe.

Benefits

  • Du télétravail et de la flexibilité pour s’adapter à vos obligations familiales
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale favorisant la créativité et l’innovation
  • Horaires flexibles (selon le type de contrat de travail)
  • Congés en cas de maladie et à l’occasion d’événements familiaux
  • Outils informatiques adaptés
  • Espace de travail épanouissant et motivant
  • Initiatives sociales et environnementales
  • Programme d’apprentissage en milieu de travail
  • Cheminement de carrière

SALAIRE

Le salaire sera calculé sur la base du taux horaire moyen correspondant à votre profil.

LIEU DE TRAVAIL

Lanaudière - Télétravail avec possibilité de présence occasionnelle

POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA ?

TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l’excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l’échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d’accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l’excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.

Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connaît une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.

Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergure.

TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.

Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l’équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

AI Systems Engineer (LLM & AI Agent Development)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a highly technical AI Systems Engineer to help build, maintain, and expand a growing ecosystem of AI-powered applications, autonomous agents, and internal software systems.

This is an execution-focused engineering role. You will work directly with the founder to implement AI architectures, build new AI-driven features, improve existing systems, and rapidly deliver production-ready solutions.

We are specifically looking for someone who has built sophisticated AI systems in production—not someone who has simply used ChatGPT or experimented with prompt engineering.

Responsibilities

AI Systems Development

  • Build and maintain AI-powered web applications.
  • Develop and improve autonomous AI agent systems.
  • Implement multi-agent workflows and orchestration.
  • Build AI systems where multiple agents coordinate under a master orchestrator.
  • Develop recursive AI workflows and advanced automation pipelines.
  • Integrate LLMs into production applications and internal tools.

Product & Platform Development

  • Expand and maintain an internally developed CRM platform.
  • Build new features across multiple AI-powered products.
  • Improve production systems through debugging, optimization, and ongoing enhancements.
  • Build scalable backend services and APIs.
  • Collaborate directly with the founder to rapidly execute product ideas.

Integrations & Automation

  • Integrate AI applications with HubSpot and other business systems.
  • Build API integrations between internal platforms and third-party applications.
  • Improve workflow automation and data synchronization across multiple systems.
  • Support AI-powered business assistants and internal automation tools.

AI Architecture & Agent Ecosystems

  • Build and maintain graph memory architectures.
  • Design secure information-sharing between AI agents.
  • Implement memory management and data segmentation strategies.
  • Ensure privacy controls and security boundaries across AI systems.
  • Optimize AI performance, reliability, and scalability.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong experience building production AI applications.
  • Proven experience developing autonomous AI agent systems.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent orchestration and AI workflows.
  • Strong Python development experience.
  • Strong Node.js development experience.
  • Working knowledge of Java.
  • Experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into production software.
  • Strong prompt engineering experience for production environments.
  • Experience building AI systems with graph memory and agent memory management.
  • Experience designing secure AI architectures with data segmentation and privacy controls.
  • Experience integrating APIs and business platforms.
  • Hands-on experience integrating HubSpot or Salesforce into custom applications.
  • Strong understanding of modern web application development.
  • Experience using:
    • Claude Code
    • Cursor
    • Replit
    • OpenClaw (or equivalent AI engineering frameworks)
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You have built sophisticated AI systems that are running in production.
  • You enjoy implementing complex technical solutions quickly and accurately.
  • You are comfortable working directly with a founder and turning ideas into working software.
  • You proactively solve problems without waiting for detailed specifications.
  • You thrive in fast-moving startup environments.
  • You communicate clearly and are comfortable discussing technical topics live with stakeholders.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

You'll spend most of your day building and improving AI-powered applications, expanding autonomous agent workflows, integrating business systems, and implementing new features across multiple products.

You'll work closely with the founder to execute technical requirements, optimize production systems, build new AI capabilities, and continuously improve the company's AI ecosystem.

Success in this role comes from delivering reliable, scalable AI systems that help automate business operations and accelerate product development.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Screening
  2. Live Technical Interview
  3. Offer Stage

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you'll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video.

It's a short, self-recorded video completed on your own time and is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you'll have one opportunity to introduce yourself and showcase your communication skills. Hiring managers review your video before scheduling interviews, making the hiring process faster and more efficient.

Please watch for the invitation from Spark Hire in both your inbox and spam folder.

Symetra's AI Enablement team is a fast-growing team of builders inside our Data Analytics organization.   • Test your code and help keep our automation and delivery running smoothly.
  • Help investigate and fix production issues.
  • Support interns and entry-level engineers as you grow.

jobs.excerpt: Working HoursAs required by contract; flexible depending on training delivery.
jobs.description:
Working Hours

As required by contract; flexible depending on training delivery.

Work Pattern

Remote, with travel as required.

Travel Requirements

International, sometimes at short notice

On-Call / Shift Work

May be called to deploy if there is a major incident

Special Conditions

Background checks required.

Purpose of the Role

The Crisis Communications Associate is a freelance, ad hoc role within Kenyon's global network of Associates, providing specialist crisis communications expertise to support clients in preparing for, responding to and recovering from crisis incidents.

Working alongside Kenyon's consultants and operational teams, the Associate delivers crisis communications training, workshops and exercises to help strengthen client preparedness. During live incidents, the Associate may be deployed to provide practical communications support, working as part of an integrated crisis management team to develop messaging, advise senior leaders, support media engagement, manage stakeholder communications and help protect organisational reputation during high-pressure situations.

This role requires individuals who can quickly adapt to different client environments, work collaboratively within multidisciplinary response teams and provide calm, professional advice in complex and fast-moving situations. Associates are engaged on an as-needed basis for both preparedness activities and operational deployments, with opportunities to support clients across a range of industries and geographical locations.

Associates are engaged on an as-needed basis for both preparedness activities and operational deployments, supporting clients across aviation and other highly regulated or high-risk sectors, including transportation, oil & gas, hospitality, manufacturing, government, energy and critical infrastructure.

Scope & Decision-Making Authority

Autonomous Decision making:

  • Makes informed decisions within their area of expertise while recognising when issues should be escalated to the Crisis Communications Lead, Deployment Lead or client representatives.

  • Exercises professional judgement to adapt training materials and facilitation techniques to suit the audience, sector and learning objectives while maintaining alignment with Kenyon's quality standards.

Escalation points:

  • Any changes to approved content, course objectives, or regulatory wording.

  • Escalate decisions that could affect the delivery of services, client expectations, contractual commitments or commercial agreements.

  • Budget-related decisions, including travel or material costs outside pre‑approved limits.

  • Issues involving risk, compliance, safeguarding, or matters that affect crisis‑response strategy.

Cross Functional Authority:

  • May collaborate with operations, deployment teams, SMEs and Product but cannot commit other teams to deadlines or deliverables without approval.

  • May coordinate with clients on logistics but cannot negotiate contractual terms or service levels.

  • No authority to approve vendor contracts, technology tools, or external suppliers

Geographic/Business Unit Scope:

  • Supports training across the full Kenyon Emergency Services business unit.

  • May be deployed globally

Key Relationships

Internal

  • Training Manager

  • Training Administrator

  • Head of Product Development

  • Operations

  • SME’s

  • VP Crisis Communications

External

  • Delegates receiving training and consultancy

  • Aviation operators during planning and exercise activities

  • Clients across aviation, transportation, hospitality, energy, manufacturing, government and other high-risk industries during planning, training and exercise activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review, develop and write Crisis Communications Plans aligned with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards and organisational best practice across multiple sectors.

  • Deliver high‑quality, interactive training in person and virtually via Microsoft Teams.

  • Design, facilitate and evaluate Crisis Communications exercises including tabletop, input‑response and full‑scale live exercises.

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of crisis communications best practices, regulatory requirements and emerging issues across aviation and other high-risk industries.

  • Participate in internal training days, CPD activities and deployment readiness sessions.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams and represent Kenyon professionally with clients and stakeholders.

  • Work with Product to design and develop new or bespoke training products.

  • Travel internationally as required to support training and exercises.

  • Including, but not limited to: advising Communications Teams, delivering just-in-time spokesperson training, drafting and reviewing internal and external communications, analysing Media Call Centre insights, and providing strategic advice on reputation and brand protection

Key Metrics for Success

  • Deliver training sessions with an average NPS rating of 80 or above

  • Timely and accurate completion of all training related documentation and reports

AI & Digital Competency

TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation. Every role is expected to actively engage with AI tools and digital ways of working to drive efficiency, quality, and innovation.

AI Fluency Tier

Tier 1— AI User

Profile - Uses AI-assisted tools in daily workflows

Expectations - Confidently uses AI features in existing tools (e.g. copilots, smart search, assisted drafting). Understands when AI output needs human review. Completes AI User onboarding within 30 days.

Role-Specific AI & Digital Skills

  • Generate quick-read overviews (e.g., risk summaries, terminology glossaries) to support personal preparation — not for client distribution.

  • Use AI‑enabled scheduling or coordination tools to plan multi‑time‑zone sessions and streamline communication with clients.

  • Use AI transcription tools to capture key points or questions during virtual sessions for internal follow-up.

  • Use internal copilots to improve reporting & documentation. Review AI output critically to ensure accuracy before submission.

AI Development & Growth

  • Share effective prompts, templates and best practices with the wider training community.

  • Participate in internal AI knowledge‑sharing sessions and contribute use‑case examples.

Competencies & Behaviours

  • Customer Centricity — Keeps client needs at the centre of decisions.

  • Collaboration — Works effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Delivery Focus — Meets commitments reliably with high-quality outputs.

  • Innovation — Identifies opportunities to improve training using technology and AI.

  • Professional Judgement — Applies sound decision‑making during training.

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Expertise in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience

  • Demonstrable experience in crisis communications, corporate communications, public relations, media relations or reputation management.

  • Experience of developing and delivering crisis communications strategies during high-profile or complex incidents.

  • Experience of writing and reviewing a wide range of communications materials, including media statements, holding statements, internal communications, Q&As, briefing notes and stakeholder communications.

  • Experience of providing communications advice to senior leaders and key stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, accurate and timely communications under pressure.

  • Ability to work effectively in high-pressure, fast-paced and rapidly changing environments.

  • Strong facilitation, presentation and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong understanding of traditional, digital and social media and their role during crisis situations.

  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel).

  • Experience delivering virtual training via Microsoft Teams or similar platforms.

  • Commitment to ongoing learning and staying current with evolving standards.

  • Strong English language communication (written and verbal).

  • Experience working within aviation, oil & gas, hospitality, emergency services, humanitarian response, government or other high-risk, highly regulate industries.

  • Media spokesperson coaching experience.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Additional language skills (priority): Korean, Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, German, Italian, Arabic, French, Turkish

Resolve all material issues in a case to establish the background, reputation, character, suitability, or qualifications of the subject under investigation.   • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to:

    • Listen attentively to others, respond appropriately to nonverbal cues, and make clear and convincing oral presentations
    • Maintain strong relationships with diverse individuals and handle challenging situations with tact and professionalism
    • Recognizes or uses correct English grammar, punctuation, and spelling; communicates information (for example, facts, ideas, or messages) in a succinct and organized manner; produces written information, which may include technical material that is appropriate for the intended audience
This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

We launched a new ad-supported tierin November 2022 to offer our members more choice in how they consume their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.

Our Team

The Ads Platform Engineering creates the ecosystem that spans across the “Pitch to Pay” process. It goes all the way from enabling our sales teams (and other DSPs, resellers) to engage advertisers to run their campaigns on Netflix, and cuts across inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience onboarding, targeting and delivery, measurement, reporting and finance.

Our team is new, yet we have enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Reporting Infrastructure team builds and operates the foundational systems that collect, enrich, and deliver ads-related events at scale. These systems ensure that raw signals from client devices, servers, and third-party integrations are transformed into clean, reliable, and privacy-safe data streams powering measurement, serving, reporting, and financial workflows.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

  • Experience with real-time systems a must

  • Extensive experience in building large-scale, low-latency distributed systems and real-time data processing

  • Experience building low-latency, highly available pipelines to ingest billions of ad events daily from client and server endpoints.

  • Experience building monitoring, alerting, and auditing systems to guarantee end-to-end data accuracy, timeliness, and completeness.

  • Hands-on expertise building and integrating with ad technologies such as SSPs, DSPs, or Ad Servers. In-depth understanding of programmatic advertising.

  • Expertise in building and integrating APIs and services with data technologies such as Apache Druid for real-time analytics and data processing

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Stream processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Flink)

  • Real-time event processing systems

  • Distributed caching system

  • Experience designing event-driven or streaming data pipelines

  • Experience working in Pacing and Budgeting teams at large advertising companies

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with Apache Flink or similar streaming frameworks

  • Experience with ads infrastructure (ad serving, pacing, budgeting, measurement, or attribution)

  • Experience building event ingestion pipelines

  • Familiarity with streaming analytics systems

  • Experience working with large-scale event pipelines (millions+ events/sec)

  • Streaming Analytics

Spotlight on CBP Engineering Teams:

Creative Workflows

The Media Production Suite (MPS) Creative Workflows team sits at the intersection of filmmaking, large‑scale distributed systems, and generative AI. We build cloud‑native pipelines that transform petabytes of raw camera footage from sets worldwide into secure, high‑quality, color/sound/framing‑accurate deliverables that creatives rely on—typically within hours of shooting (these are the “dailies”). Dailies have traditionally been managed by human operators; we’re rethinking that end‑to‑end, using automation and generative AI in every part of the workflow—from intelligent metadata extraction and quality checks to smarter routing, prioritization, and review experiences.

Localization Technology

The Logistics Management squad is the operational backbone of Netflix's localization platform. We own the tools, workflows, and infrastructure through which every piece of content is ordered, tracked, fulfilled, and paid for — across 2,700 weekly internal users and 180+ external vendors. Our role is to build the platform layer that makes AI-first localization possible. The 18-24 month vision is to automate 70-80% of localization workflows so that human effort shifts from execution to governance and the highest-impact decisions. We are the team that makes that shift real: every workflow we automate, every manual handoff we eliminate, and every vendor dependency we reduce is a step toward localization operating at internet speed. Critically, localization is not downstream of Netflix's content pipeline — it is inside it. Content cannot play for international audiences until it is localized.

The Core Catalog team creates products that advance Netflix innovation and subscriber offerings.
