We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and are building an in-house world-class ad tech ecosystem to offer our members more choices in consuming their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.

Our Team

The Ads Engineering team at Netflix is dedicated to creating a world-class advertising ecosystem that drives our advertising business. This team's mission is to develop advanced technology that ensures exceptional experiences for both our members and advertisers. Our responsibilities encompass a broad spectrum of products, ranging from sales and media planning to optimizing advertiser outcomes and execution. This includes inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience and identity management, measurement, reporting, and finance.

We use several Netflix investments and innovations - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding, and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving so that members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

Our team is faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate us and become a market leader in record time. Our roles come with expectations of delivering in a rapid clip, comfort with lofty goals and big ambitions, the visibility that comes with strategic initiatives, and responsibility and an appetite to operate like a startup within an established company.

We are looking for engineers to join us on this journey, to be a part of some exciting initiatives, and the talented teams who work on realizing our ambitious vision.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

  • Well grounded domain experience in any of the following areas: Ad Serving, Ads Identity & Audiences, Ads Creatives, Inventory & Forecasting, Campaign Management, Media Planning, Measurement, Reporting, or Ads Finance.

  • General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape.

  • Worked closely with ad operations to enable campaign setup, targeting, reporting and advertiser needs.

  • Developed many cloud based applications and comfortable with modern programming languages (preferably object oriented),

  • Familiar with A/B testing and experimentation.

  • Have solid experience in setting technical directions for engineering projects, making architectural decisions, and influencing partner and cross-functional teams.

Nice to haves:

  • Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

  • Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.

  • Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of it’s unique constraints

Spotlight on Ads Engineering Teams:

The Ad Supply teammanages the policies and technical integrations for third-party ad supply. While Netflix has traditionally licensed content, we're exploring this alternative funding model. The team solves complex challenges, such as determining how both Netflix and the third-party partner can sell ad inventory for the same content without conflict. They establish clear rules for inventory sharing, campaign setup, and system configurations to ensure consistency and fairness.

The Ads Measurement teambuilds systems that enable advertisers on Netflix to quantify campaign outcomes. Leveraging a blend of Netflix innovations and both first-party and third-party solutions, we deliver ads that respect the viewing experience while driving impactful results for advertisers. Our tools empower advertisers to effectively measure and analyze these outcomes.

The Ads Identity and Audience teamis dedicated to delivering a relevant and engaging advertising experience while prioritizing consumer privacy. Our mission is to maintain precise subscriber identities to ensure that ads are not only engaging but also respectful of consumer privacy choices and regional regulations. We maintain a high-quality Identity Graph, which is used for various purposes, including respecting privacy choices and regulations, audience onboarding, targeting, measurement, and reporting.

The Ads Creatives & Policy teamat Netflix is at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that enhance the ad experience for both viewers and advertisers. We are responsible for managing the lifecycle of ad creatives, ensuring compliance with policies, and leveraging cutting-edge technology to optimize ad delivery. Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your contributions directly impact the viewing experience of millions worldwide.

The Ads Media Planning teamis at the heart of designing and delivering state-of-the-art media planning solutions that power Netflix’s advertising business. We are developing innovative, in-house ad tech systems that enable advertisers and internal partners to efficiently plan, allocate, and optimize media investments across Netflix’s platform. Our technology translates advertiser objectives into actionable media plans, ensuring seamless integration, automation, optimization, compliance, and management of media strategies at scale. We work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust media planning capabilities that serve our advertisers, members, and Netflix’s broader business goals.

The Live Ads Management teamis driving one of Netflix’s most exciting frontiers — bringing advertising to Live Events. We’re building the intelligence that powers ad experiences during some of Netflix’s biggest real-time moments, from live sports to global specials. Our team develops smart, scalable capabilities that help ad operations plan, set up, and deliver ads seamlessly during live broadcasts. We’re pushing the boundaries with automated manifest generation, machine learning–driven optimizations, and agentic workflows that adapt in real-time to maximize both monetization and viewer experience. We work hand in hand with creative, streaming, and ads engineering teams to make advertising on Netflix Live feel effortless — blending storytelling, technology, and real-time decisioning into one unforgettable experience. It’s a fast-moving, high-visibility team shaping how live entertainment and advertising come together on a global stage.

The Ads Platform Foundations teambuilds the core platforms, frameworks, and shared services that accelerate development across the Ads organization. We focus on enabling teams to move faster and build consistently through scalable UI infrastructure, common components, and foundational workflows. Our work also powers access control across domains and underpins core systems such as Public API, GenAI foundations, and the Ads Entity Service — a knowledge graph connecting all Ads entities. Together, we provide the technical backbone that drives consistency, reliability, and velocity across Ads.

The Ads Campaign Management teamis responsible for our in-house Order Management System (OMS) used by our account managers to facilitate the booking and execution of advertising campaigns on behalf of Agencies, Brands, and Advertisers. The team owns key parts of our campaign hierarchy (Orders, Line Items) and closely intersects with almost every other team across Ads Engineering (Creatives, Forecasting, Audiences, Measurement, Ad Serving, etc) as well as business teams across Account Management and Ad Operations to facilitate the set-up, execution, and monitoring of ads across the Netflix ecosystem.

The Ads Inventory Management & Forecasting teambuilds state-of-art real-time inventory forecasting solutions leveraging ML models and high-performance ad server simulations. The team also builds systems that enable publisher inventory management solutions, which support various monetization strategies such as dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory split, and yield optimization.

The Ads Data Clean Room teamis redefining how clean rooms are used in digital advertising. We’re building data collaboration tools as internal services, allowing multiple teams to share data with external partners in a convenient and privacy-safe way. Our scope extends beyond traditional clean room use cases to include novel integrations where data has traditionally been shared more openly. As the ads data landscape evolves, our team will continue to lead by creating new ways to enable collaboration while protecting privacy.

The Ads Finance team’s vision is to establish a compliant, accurate, automated, and omni-channel Finance and billing system that streamlines and optimizes financial operations for ads, with a core charter to create a unified and compliant Revenue Recognition layer, Automate billing, Invoicing and Journal processes. The Ads Finance platform centralizes and validates all the raw data—from campaign performance to pricing structures—needed to calculate and bill our diverse advertising revenue streams. This ensures financial integrity and consistency, providing a reliable foundation for all core Ad business operations, including budgeting, predicting future revenue, and managing credit and pricing strategies.

The Ads Eventing teambuilds and operates the foundational systems that collect, validate, enrich, and deliver ads-related events at a massive scale. These high-throughput data pipelines ingest raw signals from client devices (TV, mobile), server-side ad insertions, and external third-party integrations. The core mission is to transform these raw signals into clean, reliable, and privacy-safe data streams, ensuring data quality and fidelity across the board. This critical infrastructure directly powers all core downstream functions, including real-time ad serving decisions, robust measurement and attribution systems, and financial reconciliation and billing workflows.

The Ads Reporting Infrastructure teamis responsible for delivering the final, actionable data to stakeholders. Their focus is on building the systems that consume validated and enriched ads delivery data to power the comprehensive reporting surfaces used by internal teams and advertisers to analyze campaign performance and business outcomes. They ensure the data presented is accurate, timely, and easy to consume, enabling key functions like measurement and attribution analysis, financial reconciliation, and strategic decision-making based on business results.

Our intuitive UI and intelligent automation agents surface critical, actionable insights, empowering our sales teams to cut through the noise, focus on high-value client engagements, and accelerate the success of Netflix Ads.

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

  • Core Accounts:We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

  • Account Intelligence:We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

  • Account Cohort and Verification Automation:Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

  • Spend Attribution:We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

  • 7+ years of experience building cloud-based applications with modern programming languages

  • 4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

  • Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

  • Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Sincelaunchingour ad-supported tier in 2022, the momentum has been unstoppable—we reach over94 millionglobal monthly active users! As we enter ourfourth year, our ambition is massive, and we are just getting started.

About The Team

The Live Ad Insertions team sits at the intersection of broadcast engineering, streaming infrastructure, and digital advertising. Our mission is to deliver a seamless, high-reliability ad insertion experience across live and linear streams, from primetime tentpole events like the NFL and live sports to 24/7 linear feeds and breaking news. We own the full stack of tools, systems, and operational infrastructure required to trigger, stitch, monitor, and verify ad breaks in real time at scale, without compromising the member experience.

Live advertising is one of the highest-stakes, highest-reward surfaces in CTV. When tens of millions of concurrent viewers are watching a single event, there are no second chances. A break happens once, in real time, and the window to act is measured in seconds. That demands more than reliable systems: it demands proactive observability tooling that can detect anomalies before they surface to members, and the ability to make real-time corrections mid-event when something does go wrong. This team operates with the precision of a broadcast NOC and the velocity of a software startup. We are responsible for the technology that turns a live signal into a monetized ad experience, at scale, millisecond by millisecond.

As an Engineering Manager, You Will

Lead a team of engineers building the real-time infrastructure, tooling, and operational systems for live ad insertion across server-side, client-side, and server-guided delivery models.

  • Own the reliability and operational excellence of ad insertion during 24/7 linear streams and high-stakes live events, including NFL games, live sports, and awards shows.

  • Define the technical roadmap for live ad insertion, including SCTE signal ingestion and validation, ad pod management, manifest stitching, slate handling, and ad decisioning integration.

  • Partner with ad operations, broadcast engineering, content delivery, and ad serving teams to ensure seamless signal-to-slot execution from ingest to client playback.

  • Drive hiring, retention, and development of a high-performing engineering team capable of operating in a demanding live environment.

  • Establish the on-call and incident response culture for live ad systems, setting SLAs and runbooks for break-glass scenarios during high-profile live events.

  • Contextualize your team's larger advertising strategy and translate business priorities into a technically sound, executable plan.

  • Serve as the technical authority in cross-functional discussions on live ad capabilities, representing the team to leadership, partners, and vendors.

Skills and Experience We Are Seeking

Technical Skills & Domain Expertise

  • Streaming Pipelines & Architecture:Deep hands-on experience with live streaming pipelines (from ingest protocols like RTMP, SRT, or TS through to CDN) and ad insertion architectures, including SSAI, CSAI, and SGAI (HLS interstitials/DASH).

  • Broadcast Standards & Splicing:Expertise in broadcast signaling (SCTE-35, SCTE-104, SCTE-224) and manifest manipulation for ad stitching, alongside familiarity with master control and linear playout systems.

  • Ad Pod Construction & Encoding:Advanced knowledge of managing live break constraints, including slate/fallback handling, break reconciliation, and encoding constraints (codec/bitrate matching, frame rate alignment) to prevent playback artifacts.

  • Ad Tech Decisioning:Strong understanding of ad servers, DSPs, and VAST 4.x/VMAP in live contexts, with a focus on managing strict decisioning latency budgets, timeout handling, tracking event firing, and mitigating the cascading effects of decision failures.

  • Operational Tooling:Proven track record of engineering for high-availability, zero-downtime live events, including building operational tooling for ad ops (e.g., real-time fill rate tracking, signal health visualization, and break monitoring workflows).

Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • 10+ years of total engineering experience with 3+ years managing software engineering teams in a live media, streaming, or ad tech context.

  • Ability to operate in a flat, fast-moving organization, balancing long-term architectural investments against immediate operational needs.

  • Effective communicator across both technical and business stakeholders, including ad sales, ad operations, broadcast engineering, and executive leadership.

  • Experience collaborating with content and distribution partners, including MVPDs, vMVPDs, and broadcast networks, on joint live ad insertion implementations.

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Purpose:

You will provide engineering support for the design of substation facilities for 69kV and above for Worley and its customers as an integral part of the Power Networks team.

Responsibilities:

Independently perform tasks that typically include:

  • Substation physical design including overall engineering and analysis for new switchyards and substations, additions and modifications.
  • Preparation of specifications and provide procurement support.
  • Preparation of engineering drawings including layout and general arrangements for all major equipment and structures required for high voltage switchyards or substation. Drawings include site plans, plan and elevation views, grounding, conduit, lighting, lightning protection and shielding, control building arrangements and details, AC station service, DC systems and Bills of Material.
  • Perform auxiliary electrical power system studies including load flow, short circuit, voltage drop, protection and coordination, ampacity, and battery sizing studies.
  • Perform substation grounding calculations and studies, lightning protection and insulation coordination, lighting, bus calculations, transformer and bus sizing calculations, fault calculations, and AC and DC auxiliary system sizing calculations.
  • Perform proposal preparation, proposal estimates, and provide input to scope documents and client presentations.
  • Work in a team-oriented environment with ability to work independently or as part of a group when and as required.
  • Responsible for the quality assurance of the documents to the applicable Worley and client standards.
  • Commitment to customer service and ability to work independently on more varied and complex tasks when required.
  • Supervise/coordinate other engineers of equal and lesser experience to successfully deliver a project. Provides technical direction to subordinate team members.
  • Complete tasks in accordance with project procedures, applicable codes and/or standards, on schedule and within budget.
  • Discuss technical problems and communicate effectively with other project personnel and outside customers.
  • Perform independent audits and reviews of technical work.
  • Perform the function of a team leader that can solve complex issues and act as a lead engineer responsible for the quality of the deliverables.
  • Interface with other departmental staff, project management, and with outside customers.
  • Ability to travel to job sites to perform site walkdown.
  • Responsible for the quality assurance of the documents to the applicable drawing standards and responsible for the proper document management procedures are followed.

What you will bring

Technical and Industry Experience:

  • Experience with power system modeling and analysis tools (e.g., ETAP, CYME, SKM).

  • Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills and ability to consistently deliver quality, accurate and timely work to Worley and its customers.

  • A sound knowledge of the fundamental requirements of the electrical engineering, and the basic requirements of other engineering fields.

  • A sound knowledge of applicable local and international standards and statutory and regulatory requirements.

  • Competent use of electrical engineering specific software.

  • Competent use of relevant software such as MS Office Suite.

  • Substantial technical land practical experience in electrical engineering in the same or similar industry including experience in working in multi-disciplinary projects and teams.

  • Experience working in project leadership role.

  • Experience in estimating project costs and writing proposal content.

  • Ideal candidate should have strong interpersonal and written communication skills that permit working efficiently alongside other senior substation engineers and designers in a team setting.

Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering and12 or more years of experience in substation design including supervisory experience.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) in the United States.

Moving forward together

We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. “Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!”

WHO ARE WE?

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based out of San Antonio, TX, but are truly a remote and telecommuting company.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The Product Lead Engineer serves as the technical authority across multiple Agile scrum teams inside a vertical product. While this role carries no personnel management responsibilities, the Product Lead Engineer has the highest technical voice within the team — setting direction, making implementation calls, and ensuring the team delivers reliable, well-engineered software. Beyond their own contributions, their output raises the technical capability of everyone around them.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

1.Technical Team Leadership

  • Serve as the technical authority within the development teams, making implementation decisions, resolving technical disagreements, and ensuring the team operates to a consistently high engineering standard.
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex features across backend, frontend, and mobile platforms — from design through deployment and monitoring — while actively guiding teammates through their portions of the work.
  • Decompose ambiguous requirements into well-scoped tasks for the team, and proactively identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks.
  • Regularly and actively contribute production code — this is a player-coach role. The Product Lead Engineer is expected to be a consistent, high-quality committer and to model the engineering standards to which the rest of the organization is held.

2.Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews that improve quality and accelerate the growth of junior engineers.
  • Mentor Software Engineers through pairing, design discussions, and regular technical guidance.
  • Drive best practices for testing, branching, documentation, and security within the team.

3.Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and Customer Success to clarify requirements, estimate accurately, and deliver reliable features on schedule.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively about technical risks, progress, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

4.Technical Ownership & Cross-Training

  • Take primary ownership of one or more significant product areas — maintaining deep expertise in their architecture, behavior, and failure modes, and serving as the authoritative resource for decisions and issues in those areas.
  • Proactively lead knowledge transfer of your owned areas to teammates, ensuring the team can operate effectively without you and no single engineer becomes a bottleneck.
  • Actively participate in cross-training led by others, developing meaningful familiarity with product areas outside your primary ownership to strengthen overall team resilience.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

Technical Quality

  • Code, designs, and architectural decisions within the domain consistently meet peer review standards without significant rework.
  • Technical debt and reliability risks in areas of ownership trend downward over time.

Delivery & Reliability

  • Complex features are delivered on schedule with accurate estimation; risks are surfaced early with proposed mitigations.
  • Production incidents in areas of ownership are resolved rapidly with durable root cause fixes.

Organizational Impact

  • Software Engineers who regularly work with this role demonstrably improve in code quality and technical judgment.
  • Technical recommendations are trusted by peers and leads without requiring repeated validation.

Leadership & Communication

  • Ambiguous requirements are clarified and decomposed without waiting for direction.
  • Feedback given in code reviews and design discussions is specific, actionable, and consistently improves the work.

WHAT DO YOU NEED?

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including production SaaS environments.
  • Deep proficiency in PHP and JavaScript/React, including design patterns, performance, and security best practices.
  • Strong command of relational database design, SQL optimization, and data modeling (MySQL/MariaDB).
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and upskill less experienced engineers.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tooling and workflows.

WHAT SETS YOU APART?

  • 7+ years of professional software development with full-stack ownership in a cloud environment.
  • Experience with cloud architecture on AWS (IaaS/PaaS) including serverless and managed databases.
  • Experience with React Native for cross-platform mobile development.
  • Working knowledge of security benchmarks: OWASP, CIS, SOC2.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience working in regulated environments with compliance requirements (HIPAA, HITECH, PCI DSS, or similar).

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU?

  • The company sponsors health insurance, long-term disability, and life insurance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.
  • 10 paid Holidays.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Work Anniversary Bonus.
  • Participation in the Employee of the Quarter Program.
  • Monthly $100 Connectivity Stipend Reimbursement.
  • RealTime matches employee 401K contributions at 100% of the first 3% invested and 50% of the next 2% invested.

At the planning scale, the engine produces volumetric radio maps — coverage, SINR, and best‑server maps at multiple resolutions, composable across cells, frequencies, and beam configurations — that network operators use to design and optimise deployments. At the real‑time scale, the same engine delivers per‑link multipath channel updates at the millisecond cadence that a production RAN stack requires, using adaptive algorithms that exploit temporal coherence to avoid recomputing what hasn't changed. Laying the foundations for real‑time ray tracing on GPU hardware — algorithms, data structures, and multi‑GPU scaling strategies that make sub‑millisecond propagation updates feasible — is the defining technical challenge of this role.

What we need to see:

  • PhD in computer graphics, high‑performance computing, computational electromagnetics, or a closely related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of relevant experience.

  • Hands‑on proficiency with CUDA and at least one GPU ray‑tracing framework (OptiX, Vulkan RT, Embree), with a track record of writing production‑quality GPU code.

  • Proficiency in GPU‑friendly spatial data structures (BVH, space‑filling curves, hash maps) and the ability to reason about memory hierarchy, occupancy, and compute‑vs‑bandwidth trade‑offs at the kernel level.

  • Working knowledge of electromagnetic wave propagation phenomena (reflection, transmission, diffraction, scattering) sufficient to implement and validate a propagation engine.

  • Impactful publications in GPU ray tracing, real‑time rendering, or deterministic propagation modelling.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with real‑time or near‑real‑time ray‑tracing engines shipping in production systems.

  • Prior work on multi‑GPU partitioning for ray‑tracing or large‑scale simulation workloads.

  • Familiarity with 3GPP channel models and wireless network planning tools.

  • Knowledge of geospatial coordinate systems and tiling schemes.

jobs.excerpt: EdOps School Finance Specialist The school finance specialist position is ideal for an individual looking to apply accounting, finance, business, and analytical skills to the social sector.
jobs.description:
EdOps School Finance Specialist

The school finance specialist position is ideal for an individual looking to apply accounting, finance, business, and analytical skills to the social sector. You will have the opportunity to support schools with their day-to-day operations as well as help drive strategic decisions with data-driven insights.

Reports to a Finance Team Manager. Location flexible.

Who we are:

EdOps is a B-Corp which partners with schools to provide expert support in finance, accounting, and student data management, helping education leaders make informed decisions while minimizing the financial, operational, and compliance burdens of running a school. Simply put, we make it easier for school leaders to increase student achievement. Our experience working with a wide range of schools – from newly authorized charter schools to independent schools with century-long histories, and from microschools to multi-campus networks – allows us to provide high-quality finance, accounting, and student data support across diverse educational environments.

Our team of over 100 professionals currently serves over 100 independent and public charter schools and networks across D.C., Louisiana, Maryland, Missouri, Michigan, New Jersey, and New York. We are serious about being the best possible partners to schools, and it shows in our 93% annual client retention rate. We work hard at being a rewarding, enjoyable workplace where staff can grow professionally and make an impact. We are looking for education focused, accounting and finance loving, collaborative people to join our team.

What you will do:

  • Serve as an outsourced accountant and financial advisor for a portfolio of schools
  • Oversee all day-to-day full-cycle accounting and compliance aspects of the schools, including accounts payable, payroll, grants administration, and regulatory compliance.
  • Close the books monthly/quarterly/annually and prepare monthly financial statements.
  • Project manage schools’ annual fiscal audit, completing necessary end of year statements and schedules, serve as schools' primary contact during field work and assist with 990 preparation
  • Analyze, model, and solve problems on a wide range of business issues.
  • Liaise with the state education authority (SEA), and the charter authorizer as relevant.
  • Partner with EdOps School Finance Manager to provide high quality customer service.
  • Invest in other members of the EdOps team, supporting their efforts and demonstrating a desire to contribute to the growth of the internal team.

What you will accomplish:

  • By Year 1 you will:
    • Solve small, real problems for schools on a daily basis.
    • Learn the accounting and finance cycle of school finance
    • Learn the ins-and-outs of annual school fiscal compliance reporting
    • Work with several schools in different stages of growth and with different academic models.
    • Own the day-to-day financial and monthly accounting close process for multiple schools.
    • Independently manage the annual financial cycle for a portfolio of schools.
    • Serve as an integral part of several internal teams demonstrating a strong desire to help.
  • By Year 2 you will:
    • Continue to solve small and real problems for schools every day.
    • Refine skills learned in year 1 resulting in independent and proficient completion of cyclical compliance reporting and annual fiscal audit.
    • Develop deep expertise in charter school accounting and financial compliance reporting.
    • Potential to develop a specialization (e.g. facilities finance, quality assurance, regional expertise, etc.) that supports the broader team.

Who you are:

  • Find joy in solving accounting and financial problems for individual schools. The little things make schools actually work.
  • Care about education and outcomes for students as much as you care about well-designed accounting processes.
  • Able to zoom in and out between high level strategic perspective and detailed, daily accounting and financial work.
  • Desire to be involved in the accounting and financial processes from input to analysis. Strong in independent problem solving. We are a very collaborative community that supports each other, but our specialists solve new problems every day.
  • Energized by being in a customer service role, as we are here first and foremost to serve our school clients.
  • Know schools and how they work .
  • Committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Open to learning and growing in these areas together so that each of us can contribute to building a culture of equity and support our schools in advancing these values. Please see more on EdOps's commitment here.

What you need:

  • Strong organization and time management skills. There is a lot going on here.
  • Intermediate Excel knowledge, such as formulas like vlookups and sumifs, because Excel will be your best friend in your everyday accounting and financial work.
  • Direct work experience and/or degree in finance or accounting or related field.
  • Strong quantitative analysis, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, as every school is different, and approaches and solutions often have to be customized.
  • Ability to collaborate with people at every level of an organization with a strong desire to help others do their best work.
  • Strong client communication and interpersonal skills, including presenting and explaining info (both verbally and in writing) to people with varying financial literacy. In one day, you might email a school business manager about reclassifying expenses and answer an auditor’s technical accounting question.
  • Experience with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Intacct or Blackbaud
  • General comfort with technology systems (e.g., Google suite, financial systems) because we are not big fans of paper at EdOps.
  • Work experience: typically, Finance Specialists have 5-8 years of work or post-secondary educational experience.

What you get:

  • Purpose driven work focusing on student achievement through operational excellence. That is what it is all about.
  • An opportunity to work every day with colleagues who are committed to kids and supportive of each other’s efforts….and
  • EdOps salaries are commensurate with relative experience and geographic location. The range for the School Finance Specialist position is $64,931-$89,605/year.
  • Check out other perks of working at EdOps here. And some details on benefits here.

We know that a team from a wide range of backgrounds with different life experiences, identities, opinions, and talents makes us better able to innovate and deliver on our mission of supporting schools to improve student outcomes. Every day we work to build an inclusive company culture where everyone can be themselves at work and do their best work.

Apply:

If you are passionate about our mission, skilled in your field, ready to learn, and looking for a place where you can be yourself, we want to hear from you! To apply, please complete our application

What you can expect from the hiring process:

Salary: $66,717 – $92,069 / year

Radiology Associates of Florida, a Radiology Partners practice, is seeking a remote General/Emergency Radiologist to join our evening/swing shift team.   • Enjoy consistent communication and collaboration with referring physicians
  • Leverage a collaborative team environment - you'll never work alone, even on evening shifts

  • Competitive compensation plus performance-based bonuses
  • Optional moonlighting during off-weeks — read when you want, no obligation

  • Our state-of-the-art IT infrastructure ensures efficiency and seamless collaboration across the practice:
  • Unified PACS platform connecting all RAF sites with a smart, subspecialty-aware worklist
  • Built-in communication tools for easy case sharing, consultations, and real-time support
  • 24/7 access to radiology assistants and dedicated IT support
  • Advanced AI-powered tools, including:
    • Automatic detection of urgent findings (e.g., intracranial hemorrhage, fractures, pulmonary embolism)
    • AI-assisted searches for evidence-based guidelines and decision support
    • Generative AI integrated into PowerScribe for automatic, personalized impression generation

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW

RAF is a leading radiology practice in Florida. We serve the most prestigious, established health systems in the state, including on the east and west coasts, the Florida Panhandle, and the Keys. Our scale affords our practice stability and affords our radiologists flexibility in study mix and scheduling. We also recognize that scale alone does not beget excellence. We are quality-oriented, and we practice radiology at the cutting edge, encouraging subspecialty-level interpretations across the practice, and facilitating collaboration and consultation between our radiologists. Our state-of-the-art IT suite includes universal PACS across the practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets.

Our practice is locally and democratically led, with decisions vested in the hands of the group at large, rather than in a few founders or a small group of shareholders. We are the teaching physicians for the University of South Florida Department of Radiology in Tampa. In Sarasota, our physicians’ staff the Florida State University College of Medicine, hosting medical students in their 3rd and 4th years. We also invite residents from the FSU Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine Residency programs to rotate in our departments.

Our diverse group of radiologists work and socialize together in our communities around Florida. Even between our communities across the state, we are one practice. We look forward to letting you get to know us better!

Get to know our practice! www.radflorida.com.

  • Board eligible or board certified by the American Board of Radiology (ABR) or American Osteopathic Board of Radiology (AOBR)

  • Medical license or eligibility to obtain licensure in the state of Florida

POSITION SUMMARY

Radiology Associates of Florida (RAF) seeks aremote, full-time evening neuroradiologist to staff the evening shift (3 pm - 11 pm EST) at Tampa General Hospital in an academic role. This position is 7 on/7 off with a 100% focused neuro case mix. In Tampa, we serve a growing health care system that is a stroke center of excellence and collaborate with our other RAF divisions around the state to offer candidates an optimal study mix. We perform a full breadth of neuroradiology examinations, including in the domains of trauma, stroke (including CT perfusion with RAPID software), oncology, dementia, movement disorders, and functional MRI.

We are affiliated with the University of South Florida. We have eight residents per year and one neuroradiology fellow. Our ideal candidate has an interest in teaching neuroradiology, particularly to the fellow. This position offers the opportunity for faculty appointment. Dedicated didactic lectures are not required but are welcome.

We have a team-based style of practice, and our next neuroradiologist will be able to collaborate with an experienced team of subspecialists.

We offer an internal moonlighting program with unmatched flexibility, allowing radiologists to moonlight from home as much or as little as they prefer, without having to commit to extra shifts.

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW

RAF is the largest radiology practice in Florida. We serve the most prestigious, established health systems in the state, including on the east and west coasts, the Florida Panhandle, and the Keys. Our scale affords our practice stability and affords our radiologists flexibility in study mix and scheduling. We also recognize that scale alone does not beget excellence. We are quality-oriented, and we practice radiology at the cutting edge, encouraging subspecialty-level interpretations across the practice, and facilitating collaboration and consultation between our radiologists.

Our state-of-the-art IT suite includes universal PACS across the practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets.

Our practice is locally and democratically led, with decisions vested in the hands of the group at large, rather than in a few founders or a small group of shareholders. We are the teaching physicians for the University of South Florida Department of Radiology in Tampa. In Sarasota, our physicians staff the Florida State University College of Medicine, hosting medical students in their 3rd and 4th years. We also invite residents from the FSU Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine Residency programs to rotate in our departments.

Our diverse group of radiologists works and socializes together in our communities around Florida. Even between our communities across the state, we are one practice. We look forward to letting you get to know us better!

In Tampa, discover blue skies and sunshine, a sparkling waterfront, world-class chefs, and family fun! There is beautiful weather year-round, with average highs of 82 degrees and average lows of 65 degrees. Florida has no state income tax, estate tax, or inheritance tax.

See where we work and play!

Bethesda Radiology Associates is seeking a Full-Time, Part-Time, or Independent Contractor Remote General Diagnostic Radiologist to join our physician-led practice serving Bethesda Hospital East, Bethesda Hospital West, and Baptist Health outpatient imaging centers throughout Palm Beach County.

This opportunity offers a flexible remote work model, competitive productivity-based compensation, and the support of one of South Florida's premier healthcare systems. Candidates may choose from multiple scheduling options, including 1 week on/1 week off or 1 week on/2 weeks off, with evening shifts available from 1pm-9pm EST or 3pm-11pm EST.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable reading a broad range of general diagnostic imaging studies, including emergency, inpatient, outpatient, stroke, and cross-sectional imaging. Fellowship training is welcomed but not required.

Our practice offers a collegial environment, direct access to leadership, and a strong physician staffing model designed to support sustainable workloads and long-term success.

Join one of the nation’s premier radiology practices in one of the country’s most desirable cities.

With a 72-year legacy of excellence, ARA is one of the largest and most established radiology groups in the country, consisting of 118 subspecialized radiologists serving hospitals and outpatient imaging centers throughout Central Texas. Position Duties & Responsibilities

As a General Body Radiologist with Austin Radiological Association (ARA), you'll join one of the nation's premier physician-led radiology practices, interpreting a diverse mix of diagnostic studies while working alongside highly collaborative subspecialty colleagues in an innovative and supportive environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Interpret a broad range of general body imaging studies, including:
    • CT
    • MRI
    • Ultrasound
    • Plain films
  • Perform light image-guided procedures as needed
  • Provide imaging services across both inpatient and outpatient settings
  • Collaborate closely with experienced subspecialty radiologists and multidisciplinary care teams
  • Deliver timely, high-quality interpretations that support exceptional patient care
  • Practice within a modern, technology-driven environment supported by robust IT infrastructure, experienced staff, and streamlined workflows

ARAandDell Medical School at The University of Texas at Austinare working together to help redefine how diagnostic imaging is designed, delivered, and leveraged to improve patient health.

ARA is committed to innovation and transforming how radiologists deliver exceptional care to hospitals, imaging centers, referring physicians, and patients.Our mission is simple: To Transform Radiology.

  • A highly collaborative, physician-led team that values mentorship and teamwork
  • Strong compensation, commencement, retention, and competitive incentive packages
  • Fellowship stipend available for qualifying fellows
  • A clearly defined partnership track with long-term career growth
  • Robust operational and IT support designed to maximize efficiency
  • A diverse and engaging case mix across inpatient and outpatient settings
  • Optional academic involvement and teaching opportunities through Dell Medical School
  • Advanced technology and AI-enabled workflow tools that enhance efficiency and patient care
  • A culture that prioritizes physician satisfaction, autonomy, innovation, and work-life balance

Whether you're completing fellowship or are an experienced radiologist seeking flexibility, stability, and professional growth, ARA offers an exceptional opportunity to build a rewarding long-term career while enjoying everything Austin has to offer.

    • Health, dental, vision, life, disability, and malpractice insurance
    • CME allowance and healthcare reimbursement
    • 401(k) with employer support
    • Family planning and telehealth benefits
    • Additional wellness benefits available

Qualifications

  • Board Certified or Board Eligible in Diagnostic Radiology by the American Board of Radiology (ABR) or the American Osteopathic Board of Radiology (AOBR)
  • Active Texas medical license or ability to obtain one
  • Comfortable interpreting a broad range of general body imaging studies
  • Strong interpersonal and collaborative communication skills

Austin offers an unmatched blend of career opportunity and lifestyle:

  • Vibrant food and music scene
  • Excellent schools and family-friendly communities
  • Outdoor recreation and year-round sunshine
  • No state income tax
  • Rapidly growing healthcare and technology hub

jobs.description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Benefícios de trabalhar na Stefanini:

  • Ambiente inclusivo: A Stefanini Group é comprometida em promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e respeitoso, onde todas as pessoas têm oportunidades iguais de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Oportunidades de carreira: Oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento contínuos. Na Stefanini Group, você terá a chance de evoluir profissionalmente e alcançar seus objetivos.
  • Ambiente colaborativo: Valorizamos a colaboração e o trabalho em equipe. Nossos colaboradores têm a oportunidade de participar de projetos desafiadores e inovadores, trabalhando lado a lado com profissionais talentosos e experientes.
  • Reconhecimento e valorização: Acreditamos que o reconhecimento é fundamental para o engajamento e a motivação dos colaboradores. Na Stefanini Group, seu trabalho será reconhecido e valorizado, através de programas de premiação e incentivos.
  • Benefícios abrangentes: Além de um ambiente de trabalho estimulante, oferecemos uma ampla gama de benefícios para todos os nossos colaboradores.

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Operations Specialist to join our growing Operations team. The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments, is data-driven, and brings a passion for process improvement and collaboration across teams.

  • Manage operational workflows across onboarding, policy administration, and bordereaux lifecycle stages to ensure data completeness, timeliness, and accuracy.

  • Support the centralization of master/reference data, ensuring consistent and auditable records across all operational systems.

  • Partner with internal teams to define and document standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Role Overview

HighLevel is accelerating its Email Marketing platform to become the AI-first communication engine for businesses worldwide. We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to transform Email Marketing from a traditional campaign builder into an intelligent, end-to-end campaign creation and automation ecosystem.

Today, HighLevel powers email creation, campaign scheduling, reporting, and lifecycle automation through Email Builder and Sequences. Your mandate is to redefine the customer experience through AI-native creation, intuitive editing interfaces, intelligent lifecycle automation, and actionable campaign intelligence — driving user adoption, activation, engagement, and revenue with a clear, metrics-driven product roadmap.




Key Responsibilities

1. Build World-Class Email Creation Experiences

  • Own the end-to-end Email Builder user experience, including drag-and-drop editors, custom HTML tools, reusable visual components, responsive templates, and real-time collaborative editing.

  • Build an industry-leading AI-native email editor that enables users to generate complete, high-converting email layouts using simple natural language prompts.

  • Lead the evolution of a natural language prompt-to-layout generation ("vibe-code") builder, allowing non-technical marketers to create production-ready emails instantaneously.

  • Deliver native multivariate experimentation tools, including subject line, body copy, layout, and Call-To-Action (CTA) A/B testing to continuously improve conversion rates.

2. Transform Email Marketing Through AI

  • Define the multi-year vision and execution strategy for Email AI, enabling automated campaign generation, brand-aware messaging, localized/multilingual copy creation, and intelligent optimization.

  • Build Sequence AI to automatically create multi-step lifecycle journeys, including onboarding, lead nurture, abandoned cart recovery, upsells, and re-engagement campaigns.

  • Partner closely with core AI teams to deliver prompt-based workflow creation, predictive recommendations, and autonomous campaign creation.

  • Maintain high standards for responsible AI, establishing guardrails around brand voice consistency, content quality evaluation, and privacy compliance.

3. Build Intelligent Campaign Delivery & Automation Workflows

  • Own execution and scheduling features, including Send Now, Scheduled Send, Timezone-aware Sending, and AI-powered Send Time Optimization.

  • Scale automated Sequences, trigger logic, dynamic branching, smart personalization fields, and event-driven marketing workflows.

  • Streamline campaign creation workflows to minimize operational complexity for marketers while maximizing end-user engagement.

4. Drive Campaign Intelligence & Customer Insights

  • Build reporting dashboards that accurately measure campaign execution, open/click engagement, conversion rates, attributed revenue, and overall ROI.

  • Deliver actionable, AI-powered recommendations that guide users on how to improve campaign engagement and conversion performance.

  • Establish robust product instrumentation, funnels, and experimentation frameworks to measure feature adoption and product-led outcomes.

5. Build Audience & Preference Management

  • Own subscriber preferences, consent management workflows, and end-user preference centers.

  • Deliver flexible preference experiences that increase customer trust and support global messaging compliance (CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR, etc.).

6. Drive Product Strategy & Execution

  • Establish a 12–18 month product roadmap for Email Marketing aligned with HighLevel’s broader product strategy.

  • Conduct continuous customer discovery, competitive analysis, and usability research.

  • Author clear, outcome-focused PRDs and partner closely with Engineering, Product Design, AI, Customer Success, and Go-To-Market teams.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

  • Formulate a strategic vision and roadmap for the Email Builder and AI-powered campaign lifecycle.

Showcase Agentic Experience suite, Spark Workspace and Spark Connect scenarios in front of client audiences. Drive discovery workshops, craft compelling proposals and RFP responses, scope effort, and coordinate with engineering to validatefeasibility (scope, timeline, budget). Your goal is to increase win rate by delivering proposals that are both visionary and credible.

IP Ownership, Go-to-Market & Thought Leadership

Define the offers, reference architectures, accelerators, and demo assets that make up the suite. Prioritize investment based on client demand and competitive differentiation; and ensure each component has clear value propositions, pricing, and delivery playbooks. Partner with Delivery and Engineering to harden field-built solutions into reusable IP and retire or refactor assets as the agentic landscape evolves.
  • Digital Workspace IP Leader (Spark Workspace & Spark Connect):Serve as the senior product owner forGenpact Experience's Digital Workspace IP, including Spark Workspace and Spark Connect. Author whitepapers, blog posts, and whitepapers; speak at industry events, Microsoft partner forums, and client roundtables; and contribute to Genpact's brand as a leading agentic systems integrator.

Agency or consulting experience strongly preferred.
  • Self-Starter with Organizational Savvy:Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You manage your own time and priorities across multiple pursuits, develop new ideas with minimal guidance, and exercise sound judgment on when to involve others.

Why Genpact Experience?

jobs.description:
About MarcoPolo Learning

MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app andThe PolosTV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.

Backed by top-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale — and we’re looking for a Financial Controller who thrives in a fast-scaling, international SaaS environment.

Role Overview

Marco Polo Learning is building a self-purchase, subscription website and end-to-end buying experience for individual customers (a "bottom-up" growth motion, distinct from our top-down sales team). We're looking for someone who sits between product design and marketing: someone who can design the look, flow, and feel of the purchase experience, and who deeply understands how subscription businesses are built and activated — pricing and packaging, onboarding and activation sequences, trial-to-paid conversion, and retention. Implementation support (website build, integrations) is available via AI tools and an engineering partner — this role is not being hired primarily for coding ability. It is being hired for the combination of design judgment and subscription marketing/business judgment: what the funnel should look like, say, and do at each step, and why.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design the self-purchase subscription experience: landing pages, sign-up, trial, and checkout — the layout, flow, and presentation of pricing/packaging.
  • Design the activation and onboarding sequence: what a new user sees, is told, and is prompted to do after signing up, so they reach their first "aha" moment and convert to paid.
  • Own the copy and messaging strategy across the funnel (emails, in-app messaging, landing pages) — writing it or directing whoever does.
  • Partner with an engineering/automation resource and/or AI tools to get the designed funnel actually built and wired up — this role directs and reviews the build, it does not need to personally code it.
  • Bring a proven subscription business background — pricing, activation, churn, and growth-loop thinking — so we are not starting from zero on funnel strategy or design.
  • Define what to test (design variations, pricing, onboarding steps, messaging) and read the results to keep improving conversion and activation.
  • Track and report on subscription funnel metrics: sign-ups, activation rate, trial-to-paid conversion, and early retention.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not primarily an engineering or coding role — implementation support is available via AI tools and an engineering partner; this hire is for the design and marketing/business thinking behind the funnel.
  • Not a purely visual/UI design role — this role needs design paired with subscription business and marketing judgment, not visual design alone.
  • Not a pure automations/ops role — this hire owns funnel design and marketing strategy and directs engineering/AI resources for execution rather than building or automating internal systems.

Requirements

  • Proven experience designing and/or growing a subscription or self-serve SaaS/consumer product — you can point to a funnel or subscription business you designed, built, or materially improved.
  • Product design skills — able to design clean, conversion-minded web and email experiences (wireframes/mockups at minimum), not just direct a designer.
  • Strong grasp of subscription business fundamentals: activation, trial-to-paid conversion, churn/retention, pricing and packaging.
  • Hands-on growth marketing experience: email/lifecycle marketing, landing page strategy, basic analytics and experimentation.
  • Comfortable directing a technical build (via AI tools or a partner engineer) even if not writing the code personally — enough fluency to know what's possible and review the output.
  • Strong written English for copywriting and stakeholder communication with a US-based team.
  • Self-directed: able to ask the right questions, propose a plan, and execute with minimal day-to-day oversight.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in EdTech or a subscription product sold to consumers/parents.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, N8N, ClickUp, or similar tools already in use at Marco Polo.
  • Enough technical/no-code fluency (Webflow, AI website builders) to prototype ideas quickly, even if the final build is handed off for implementation.

Engagement Details

Location: India-based (remote)

Engagement type: Contract to start, with potential to expand

Reports to: Founder / Leadership team

Works closely with: An engineering/automation team member who supports the technical build

Job Title: Senior Decision Scientist - Pharmacy and Consumer Wellness Analytics

Job Location: Work at Home, Rhode Island, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position description

The Pharmacy and Consumer Wellness Operations Analytics team is helping lead the effort to transform healthcare and drive improved consumer experience by partnering with key business areas across CVS Health to deliver impactful analytic solutions and insights. As a member of this team within Analytics & Behavior Change (A&BC) Data Science team, you will be at the forefront of delivering high visibility analytic projects for key CVS Retail strategic priorities. Specifically, you will have the opportunity to drive revenue and profitability in CVS Health’s Retail Pharmacy business with end-to-end analytical solutions. You will have the chance to solve complex problems, build predictive models and simulate impact of business decisions to improve profitability.

We are a fast-paced team focused on building innovative analytic solutions using advanced analytics and cloud capabilities. Within our team, we believe a cutting-edge analytics product can only be delivered if every aspect of the solution from data to model to front end UI is fully designed and developed by SMEs within the team. As a Decision Scientist, you will be part of a team driving pharmacy contracting and profitability analytics. You will be working with stakeholders and team members to identify/refine problem statement, develop options to provide analytics solutions, determine methodology to quantify the impact and develop impactful visualizations/presentations to tell the story. We are looking for talented individuals who have a strong sense of teamwork, accountability, and a desire to deliver high quality end to end intuitive and impactful analytic products using advanced data driven approaches.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and present meaningful and insights-driven materials on analytical results with recommendations and go forward planning to guide a variety of audiences including internal stakeholders and senior leadership
  • Act as the point of contact for stakeholders across multiple projects to understand strategic business analytics requirements, create document and communicate project status
  • Leverage AI tools and techniques that yield solutions to maximize productivity and profitability
  • Partner with data scientists and data engineers to define a solution approach and make recommendations.
  • Performs analyses of structured and unstructured data to solve complex business problems
  • Use data visualization techniques to effectively communicate analytical results and support business decisions.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in industry
  • 3+ years of experience programming in SQL and Python
  • 3+ years of data visualization platforms (Power BI, Tableau etc.) with experience developing POCs as well as end-to-end product implementations
  • 1+ years implementing AI based solutions for analytics and business intelligence use cases
  • Expertise in providing strategy and thought leadership around problem statement identification and analytical approaches
  • Proficiency in understanding semantic models, data models, and ability to analyze large datasets in cloud platforms
  • Strong knowledge of the underlying mathematical and statistical principles that are foundational to data science
  • Strong project management, organizational skills & Strong presentation skills with the ability to present findings and influence others as well as expertise in the use of PowerPoint
  • Experience and familiarity with cloud computing like Snowflake Azure, & GCP

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial analytics
  • Demonstrates strong ability to communicate technical concepts and implications to business partners
  • AI Savvy
  • Anticipates and prevents problems and roadblocks before they occur
  • Strong knowledge of advanced analytics tools and languages to analyze large data sets from multiple data sources
  • Demonstrates proficiency in most areas of mathematical analysis methods, machine learning, statistical analyses, and predictive modeling and in-depth specialization in some areas

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering) with 4–7+ years of relevant experience,
    OR
  • Master’s degree or equivalent in an analytic discipline with 2+ years of relevant experience.

40

Full time

$101,970.00 - $203,940.00

This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

RP El Paso is seeking a Remote General Diagnostic Radiologist to support our practice in El Paso, Texas. We have a commitment to quality and ardently promote and invest in the professional development of our radiologists through a comprehensive quality assurance program.

  • 100% Remote – workstation provided

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW
El Paso, Texas offers physicians a unique blend of professional opportunity and exceptional quality of life. Nestled against the Franklin Mountains and bordering New Mexico and Mexico, El Paso boasts over 300 days of sunshine each year, a low cost of living, and minimal traffic compared to other major Texas cities. The community is known for its welcoming culture, rich history, outstanding local cuisine, and strong sense of safety and family-friendly living. With easy access to outdoor recreation, a growing medical community, and a relaxed Southwestern lifestyle, El Paso is an ideal place to build both a rewarding career and a great life.

DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Completion of residency in accredited US Diagnostic Radiology Program
  • Board eligible or certified by American Board of Radiology or the American Osteopathic Board of Radiology
  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Osteopathy (DO), residency trained in Diagnostic Radiology
  • Medical license or eligibility to obtain licensure in the state of Texas

FOR MORE INFORMATION OR TO APPLY:

RADIOLOGY PARTNERS OVERVIEW

Radiology Partners, through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, we advance our bold mission by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

Position Description & Requirements

Position Summary

Radiology Associates of Florida is excited to announce an exciting opportunity for a Neuroradiologist to join our expending remote division. This role offers a Monday-to-Friday schedule with typical day shift hours, and participation in our monthly tumor board conference series an average of once a month. We have crafted this role to have the convenience of a teleradiologist position with the stability, teamwork and quality of a premier hybrid academic-private practice. There is also a $50K Commencement Bonus! While you will have the convenience of working from home, you will develop a relationship with your referring physicians and radiologist colleagues as you service a limited set of clients rather than a sprawling network across multiple time zones. This team of radiologists will work together, so no single radiologist will be working without support.

This role will require a neuroradiologist who is comfortable handling a diverse range of cases, with approximately 70% of clinical reads focused on neuroradiology. This role will provide expert analysis and support for emergency and general diagnostic imaging, as well as collaborating with neurosurgeons to review and interpret imaging related to pre-operative planning, intra-operative assessments, and post-operative evaluations and well as analyzing neuroimaging studies for oncology patients, including tumor detection, staging, and monitoring of treatment response.

We enjoy a state-of-the-art unified PACS software suite that aggregates all of our sites onto one smart worklist, which distributes cases intelligently based on your workload and areas of expertise. Built into PACS are convenient collaboration tools that make it as easy to share cases and consult with colleagues remotely as it would be in a communal reading room. There are also built-in communication tools to reach our 24/7 radiology assistant concierges and IT support, minimizing your need to pick up the phone. Our state-of-the-art IT suite includes universal PACS across the practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets.

jobs.title: Sr. Clinical Research Manager (Neurology)
jobs.excerpt: The Department of Neurology is seeking a Sr.  Clinical Research Manager.
jobs.description:
The Department of Neurology is seeking a Sr. Clinical Research Manager. Researchers at Johns Hopkins University conduct clinical trials and clinical studies to discover new ways to prevent and treat diseases and other health problems. The Sr. Clinical Research Manager works in collaboration with PI(s) to set the direction for research and is responsible for the overall management of a clinical trials portfolio and clinical research activities. Plans and directs clinical research operations which typically involves external partners and internal collaborators, and/or national and international networks. Responsible for managing research staff, developing and implementing effective data management and regulatory procedures, providing education to research staff, and ensuring research staff are properly trained.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with investigator(s) and exercise independent judgement in directing the conduct of the research
  • Participate in scientific discussions with collaborators, PI's, and funding organizations and contribute to decisions impacting conduct of research.
  • Responsible for the recruitment, education, training and supervision of the clinical research coordinators and regulatory personnel within the program.
  • Responsible for development and implementation of policy and procedures for clinical research within the program.
  • Facilitate effective teamwork among all involved personnel, e.g. research staff, research nursing, data management, regulatory personnel, hospital staff, etc.
  • Ensure responsible conduct of clinical research protocols throughout the lifecycle, including development, implementation, maintenance, and termination.
  • Collaborate with PIs on research protocol development and evaluation, including reviewing and assessing new protocols for clarity, thoroughness, financial and logistical feasibility, maintaining subject safety etc.
  • Oversee preparation and submissions to IRB and act as liaison for regulatory issues on behalf of the PI.
  • Track and oversee the regulatory approval process to ensure efficient study startup; assist regulatory staff with informed consent and protocol amendments for investigator-initiated studies
  • Manage clinical research budget generation and financial management of the program.
  • Ensure efficient use of centralized resources and adherence to policies as appropriate, e.g. clinical trial management system, prospective reimbursement analysis, etc.
  • Analyze resource utilization by individual trials to ensure research needs are anticipated and met.
  • Ensure adequate system for tracking and reporting clinical research milestones for financial invoicing.
  • Ensure the development, testing, and evaluation of manuals, questionnaires, and coding structures for the efficient collection of data.
  • Ensure research staff maintain complete and accurate research data and charts and are well prepared for auditing and monitoring visits.
  • Lead study meetings to examine data, decide on next steps, implement changes to protocol operations based on results and goals, and initiate sub-studies.
  • Contribute to manuscripts and presentations.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree in a related field.
  • Six years of related experience in clinical research in an academic, government, or pharmaceutical industry environment.
  • Demonstrated supervisory or lead experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of GCP/ICH and local regulations.
  • Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Master's Degree in a related field.
  • Certification as a Clinical Research Professional.
  • Formal project management training or certification.

Technical Skills & Expected Level of Proficiency

  • Budget Management - Advanced
  • Clinical Resource Knowledge - Advanced
  • Data Management and Analysis - Advanced
  • Good Clinical Practices - Advanced
  • Finance Project Management - Advanced
  • Oral and Written Communications - Advanced
  • Program Development - Advanced
  • Record Keeping - Advanced
  • Regulatory Compliance - Advanced
  • Resource Management - Advanced
  • Strategic Program Management - Advanced

The core technical skills listed are most essential; additional technical skills may be required based on specific division or department needs.

Scope and Budget Management
